statement_en: The bi-wave properties of the least-action principle describing the relativistic motion of a free charged material point follow from analysis of the motion of a charge-particle in static and variable fields of scalar and vector potentials with high symmetry.
quote_ru: Исследуются биволновые свойства принципа наименьшего действия, описывающего релятивистское движение свободной заряженной материальной точки. Они следуют из анализа движения частицы-заряда в статических и переменных полях скалярного и векторного потенциалов с высокой симметрией.

statement_en: The analysis allows one to construct the complete integral of the Hamilton-Jacobi equation, which represents a small localized excitation of the action function, discovered earlier by G. Sivashinsky.
quote_ru: Анализ позволяет построить полный интеграл уравнения Гамильтона-Якоби, который представляет собой малое локализованное возбуждение функции действия, обнаруженное ранее Г.Сивашинским.

doc_title_en: Bi-wave nature of the least-action principle of a relativistic charge-particle
doc_title_ru: Биволновая природа принципа наименьшего действия релятивистской частицы-заряда
statement_en: The complete integral contains two plane action waves associated with the moving charge-particle: one coincides with the de Broglie wave (the temporal action wave), whose phase velocity is greater than the speed of light; the other plane wave (the coordinate action wave) moves with a phase velocity smaller than the speed of light.
quote_ru: Интеграл содержит в себе две плоские волны действия, связанные с движущейся частицей-зарядом. Одна из них совпадает с де Бройлевской волной (временная волна действия), имеющей фазовую скорость больше скорости света. Другая плоская волна (координатная волна действия) движется с фазовой скоростью меньше скорости света.

quote_ru: Длина её волны зависит от скорости и при малых скоростях движения совпадает с комптоновской длиной волны.

quote_ru: В системе отсчёта, в которой покоится частица-заряд, она отображается в «пространстве действия» отрезком дрожащей струны, вытянутой в направлении её движения. Участок струны имеет пространственный масштаб, который ограничен комптоновской длиной волны, зависящей от скорости, и временной масштаб, который также зависит от скорости движения частицы-заряда.

statement_en: This representation finally refines the corpuscular-wave dualism (discovered at the beginning of the last century) into a corpuscular-bi-wave dualism: during motion of any massive charge-particle there arise not one plane wave process, as previously believed, but two, each with its own spatial and temporal scales depending on the velocity of motion; the scales differ in different inertial reference frames.
quote_ru: Такое представление позволяет окончательно уточнить явление корпускулярно-волнового дуализма, открытого в физике в начале прошлого века, которое в этом случае переходит в явление корпускулярно-биволнового дуализма. То есть, при движении любой массовой частицы-заряда возникает не один плоский волновой процесс, как считалось ранее, а два. Каждый из них имеет свои пространственные и временные масштабы, зависящие от скорости его движения. Масштабы будут различны в разных инерциальных системах отсчёта.

statement_en: The E-Emden equation, obtained in [1], belongs to the class of nonlinear second-order ordinary differential equations; together with the Emden-Fowler equation it played an important role at the first stage of solving stellar-structure problems, the stars being considered as gaseous formations in polytropic or isothermal equilibria.

Вместе с уравнением Эмдена-Фаулера оно играло важную роль на первом этапе решения задач о строении звезд, рассматриваемых как газовые образования, находящиеся в политропическом или изотермическом равновесиях [2].

statement_en: Modeling shows that an order-of-magnitude increase of cluster temperature (for the same state parameters) increases second-kind trap masses by more than an order of magnitude, and their mass range exceeds that of first-kind traps at the original temperature with only slight change of geometric sizes; at lower n₀ values the outer sizes of the clusters exceed the mean solar-system radius only by a factor of 10 to 18 (the mean radius taken as the semi-major axis of Pluto's orbit ~ 0.6·10¹⁵ cm).

statement_en: A complete system of equations is proposed describing the class of static equilibria of non-radiating, mutually interacting gravitating particles suspended in a self-consistent field.
quote_ru: Предложена полная система уравнений, которая описывает класс статических равновесий неизлучающих, взаимодействующих между собой гравитирующих частиц, взвешенных в самосогласованном поле.

doc_title_en: Mass spectrum of hollow supermassive black holes with high temperature
doc_title_ru: Спектр масс полых сверхмассивных чёрных дыр с высокой температурой
statement_en: The equilibrium distribution function of the system coincides with the Boltzmann one and indicates the reverse action of the field on the particles that create this field; in solving the problem the gravity-compensating Bernoulli force receives a new mathematical definition: it is created by a force of field origin coinciding in direction and magnitude with the pressure gradient of the system's self-consistent gravitational field; each elementary volume of the system is in equilibrium under two forces: the volume density of Newtonian attraction forces and the volume density of Bernoulli repulsion forces.
quote_ru: Равновесная функция распределения системы совпадает с больцмановской и указывает на обратное действие поля на частицы, которые это поле создают.

statement_en: Under equal conditions, field traps with a potential well retain more particles than traps with a potential gap.
quote_ru: При интегрировании Е-уравнения Эмдена для плотности газового шара возникает математическая проблема выбора граничных условий. Полную систему уравнений, решаемую относительно гравитационного потенциала, удаётся свести к трёхмерному уравнению такого же вида. Фундаментальный закон сохранения полного давления, существующий в системе с плоской симметрией, формирует полевые граничные условия. Они заключаются в наличии эквипотенциальной поверхности, в которой давление самосогласованного поля обращается в нуль, а потенциал минимален. В сферической симметрии найдены два класса аналитических решений, описывающих распределения физических параметров в системах с потенциальной ямой и потенциальной щелью. Вычисления указывают на возможность существования полых скоплений высокотемпературных нейтронов, спектр масс которых для температур от 10 11 до 1012 К попадает в диапазон масс объектов, обнаруженных в центрах галактик и названных «сверхмассивными чёрными дырами». Ключевые слова: газовый шар, полевые граничные условия, гравитационный потенциал, закон сохранения полного давления, эквипотенциальная поверхность, сферическая симметрия, аналитические решения, потенциальная яма, потенциальная щель, полые скопления высокотемпературных нейтронов, центр галактики, сверхмассивные чёрные дыры, спектр масс. statement_en: The self-consistent theory of hollow gas balls predicts the existence of low-temperature neutron clusters of small sizes: with a length scale ~10⁵ cm at temperature 100 K they have a mass scale ~2.5·10²² g, three orders of magnitude less than the Moon's mass; such light cold thin-wall neutron bubbles left their trace when falling on the lunar surface, forming a certain class of craters having an outer rim of substance melted in the form of a ring and a smooth surface texture inside the rim (see Fig. 3).
quote_ru: Самосогласованная теория полых газовых шаров предсказывает существование низкотемпературных скоплений нейтронов малых размеров. Имея масштаб длины ~ 105 cм при температуре 100 К, они обладают масштабом массы ~ 2,51022 г, что на три порядка меньше массы Луны.

statement_en: According to the theory, the Tunguska phenomenon was a hollow, loose cosmic 'snowball' of enormous mass consisting of ice nanoparticles of nanoscopic sizes, ejected by icy geysers from the depths of Enceladus, the 61st satellite of Saturn; the particle flux density at the fall of such a 'bubble' on the earth will be substantially smaller at the center than in adjacent layers, so the destructions at the epicenter will be minimal, which matches the observations of the Kulik expedition; the memory of the fall is still kept by the mast-like, not felled forest at the epicenter.
quote_ru: Из теории следует, что Тунгусский феномен представлял собой полый, рыхлый космический «снежок» огромной массы, состоящий из ледяных пылинок наноскопических размеров (подробности в [7,10]). Он был выброшен ледяными гейзерами из недр Энцелада – 61 спутника Сатурна.

doc_title_ru: Токовая неустойчивость колебательного контура при гармонической модуляции реактивного параметра
statement_en: A physical-mathematical model has been found describing the periodic change of charge in a series oscillating circuit without a current source, with capacitance varying mechanically according to a harmonic law; the equation contains three dimensionless system parameters: the quality factor, the ratio of the capacitance modulation frequency to the circuit frequency, and the reduced amplitude of the reactive-parameter modulation.
quote_ru: Найдена физико-математическая модель, которая описывает периодическое изменение заряда в последовательном колебательном контуре без источника тока с механически изменяющейся по гармоническому закону ёмкостью. В уравнение входят три безразмерных параметра системы: добротность, отношение частоты модуляции ёмкости к частоте колебательного контура, и приведённая амплитуда модуляции реактивного параметра.

doc_title_en: Current instability of an oscillating circuit under harmonic modulation of a reactive parameter
doc_title_ru: Токовая неустойчивость колебательного контура при гармонической модуляции реактивного параметра
statement_en: Numerical modeling shows that three classes of periodic solutions can exist in the system: in a low-Q circuit they are damped oscillations; in a medium-Q circuit they are beats arising from the Mandelshtam-Papaleksi parametric resonance; in a high-Q circuit a current instability can develop, which manifests itself in unlimited growth of charge oscillations and capacitance current for certain values of the reactive-parameter modulation depth.
quote_ru: Численное моделирование показывает, что в рассмотренной системе могут существовать три класса периодических решений: в низкодобротном колебательном контуре они имеют вид затухающих колебаний; в контуре со средней добротностью они имеют вид биений, возникающих при параметрическом резонансе Мандельштама-Папалекси, а в высокодобротном контуре может развиваться токовая неустойчивость. Она проявляет себя в том, что приводит к неограниченному росту колебаний заряда и тока ёмкости для определённых значений глубины модуляции реактивного параметра.

statement_en: This mechano-electric principle has been known for millions of years to flagellate bacteria moving in intercellular fluid; works published in Nature in January 2018 explained their movement principle, named flagellar motors; inside the axisymmetric bacterium body of about 100 nm diameter several membrane layers are located, each membrane made as a propeller and containing conducting radial sectors (as in Fig. 5); different bacteria have from 13 to 17 radial sectors in the rotor.
quote_ru: Отметим, что этот принцип известен миллионы лет жгутиковым бактериям, которые перемещаются в межклеточной жидкости. Опубликованные в январе 2018 года в Nature работы биологов объяснили принцип их перемещения, названный flagellar motors [6]. Внутри осесимметричного тела бактерии, диаметром порядка 100 нм, располагаются несколько слоёв мембран. Каждая мембрана выполнена в виде пропеллера и содержит в себе проводящие радиальные сектора (как на рис. 5). Различные бактерии имеют от 13 до 17 радиальных секторов в роторе. Можно оценить среднее количество разделённых зарядов для пробойной напряженности электрического поля в жидкости 5 мВ/нм. Для всей мембраны оно составляет порядок 20 электронов. То есть, на одном проводящем секторе мембраны размещается от одного до двух электронов. statement_en: Open inductors are those made as a planar spiral, creating magnetic field lines symmetrically located in both half-spaces: placing a conducting film of nanoscopic thickness on one side of such an inductor increases the total positive inductance of the system, which becomes frequency-independent; placing two identical nanoscopic-thickness conducting films on different sides of the spiral inductor further increases the positive total inductance preserving its frequency properties; a thick or multilayer film on one side can give a dynamic-inductance state — the total system inductance becomes negative and frequency-dependent; films on both sides further increase the negative inductance, and increasing the number of layers raises the total negative inductance of the open system proportionally to their count.
quote_ru: Расположение с одной стороны такого индуктора проводящей плёнки, с наноскопической толщиной, увеличит суммарную положительную индуктивность системы. Она будет частотно-независимой. Расположение с разных сторон спирального индуктора двух одинаковых проводящих плёнок с наноскопической толщиной ещё больше увеличит положительную суммарную индуктивность системы с сохранением её частотных свойств. Расположение с одной стороны спирали либо толстой проводящей, либо многослойной плёнки может дать состояние динамической индуктивности. В этом случае суммарная индуктивность системы станет отрицательной и будет зависеть от частоты. Расположение с обеих сторон спирали таких плёнок ещё больше увеличит отрицательную индуктивность системы.
geometry: films on one or both sides of planar spiral

doc_title_en: Physical properties of a flat varicap with an electron cluster
doc_title_ru: Физические свойства плоского варикапа с электронным кластером
statement_en: An elementary theory is proposed that allows finding quantitative connections between the physical quantities accompanying the effect of the appearance of a large static capacitance in a varicap with an electron cluster.
quote_ru: В заметке предложена элементарная теория, позволяющая найти количественные связи между физическими величинами, сопровождающими эффект появления большой статической ёмкости в варикапе с электронным кластером.

doc_title_en: Physical properties of a flat varicap with an electron cluster
doc_title_ru: Физические свойства плоского варикапа с электронным кластером
statement_en: A parameter of electrization of the electron cluster is introduced; it shows how many times the capacitance of the varicap with the electron cluster is greater than the capacitance of the same varicap without the cluster; the considered case is electrization of the cluster in which the response-field strength created by the electrons is greater than the external field strength.
quote_ru: Введён параметр электризации электронного кластера. Он показывает во сколько раз ёмкость варикапа с кластером электронов больше, чем ёмкость того же варикапа без кластера.

statement_en: A group of experimenters in patent [1] (Kholoshchenko, Kovalenko et al., WO 2011031189A1, 'Vacuum capacitor', 2011) discovered that the electrical capacitance of a vacuum diode with thermionic emission having an isolated anode, at high voltages between cathode and anode (tens of kilovolts), can have large differing values.
quote_ru: Группа экспериментаторов в патенте [1] обнаружила, что электрическая ёмкость вакуумного диода с термоэлектронной эмиссией, имеющего изолированный анод, при высоких напряжениях между катодом и анодом (десятки киловольт) может иметь большие различные значения.

statement_en: Fig. 1 shows schematically the distribution of the electron gas inside a vacuum cylindrical diode: 1 — diode cathode, 2 — anode removed behind the glass, 3 — glass envelope, 4 — electron gas; the diode with the anode removed behind the glass is not simply a vacuum capacitor but a capacitor in which an electron gas is used instead of a dielectric.
quote_ru: Из рисунка видно, что диод с вынесенным за стекло анодом 2 представляет собой не просто вакуумный конденсатор, а конденсатор, в котором вместо диэлектрика используется газ электронов.

doc_title_en: Physical properties of a flat varicap with an electron cluster
doc_title_ru: Физические свойства плоского варикапа с электронным кластером
statement_en: As shown in the monograph [2], a gas of like charges under certain conditions can occupy a finite volume and be held in it by forces of field origin; these forces are connected with the pressure gradient of the own electric field and balance the Coulomb forces of the interacting charges in any elementary volume of the gas; they are universal — they compensate the Coulomb interaction of opposite-sign charges in the plasmoid of ball lightning, which is a canonical state of gaseous substance in the form of a thin-walled bubble.
quote_ru: Силы полевого происхождения универсальны. Они компенсируют кулоновское взаимодействие зарядов противоположного знака в плазмоиде шаровой молнии, которая представляет собой каноническое состояние газообразного вещества в виде тонкостенного пузыря.

doc_title_en: Physical properties of a flat varicap with an electron cluster
doc_title_ru: Физические свойства плоского варикапа с электронным кластером
statement_en: The nucleus of any atom is also a thin-walled bubble of opposite charges; a plasma model of the nucleus with superhigh temperature and diameter of the order of nanometers can be built; such a model allows justifying the physical nature of nuclear forces, so far hidden from the natural scientist.
quote_ru: Ядро любого атома также представляет собой тонкостенный пузырь из разноимённых зарядов. Можно построить плазменную модель ядра со сверхвысокой температурой, имеющую диаметр порядка нанометров. Такая модель позволяет обосновать физическую природу ядерных сил, до сих пор скрытую от естествоиспытателя.

doc_title_en: Physical properties of a flat varicap with an electron cluster
doc_title_ru: Физические свойства плоского варикапа с электронным кластером
statement_en: In an electron gas the Coulomb interaction forces between the electrons turn out to be ATTRACTIVE; the charge system is balanced against possible collapse by forces of field origin acting on their mass density; precisely this property of electrons creates the conditions for a previously unknown, exceptionally beautiful physical phenomenon: CLUSTERIZATION OF ELECTRONS INTO BUBBLES OF CHARGE upon their exit from any source; this phenomenon was first discovered experimentally in 1987 by the American researcher K. Shoulders in a vacuum diode with a sharp (point) cathode.
quote_ru: Именно это свойство электронов и создаёт условия для неизвестного ранее, исключительно красивого физического явления: КЛАСТЕРИЗАЦИИ ЭЛЕКТРОНОВ В ПУЗЫРЬКИ ЗАРЯДОВ при их выходе из любого источника. Экспериментально это явление было впервые обнаружено в 1987 году американским исследователем К.Шоулдерсом в вакуумном диоде с острийным катодом [3].

doc_title_en: Physical properties of a flat varicap with an electron cluster
doc_title_ru: Физические свойства плоского варикапа с электронным кластером
statement_en: In a gas of positive charges the Coulomb forces between particles are REPULSIVE, and they are compensated against possible dispersal of the particles by forces of field origin.
quote_ru: В газе из положительных зарядов кулоновские силы между частицами РАСТАЛКИВАЮЩИЕ, а компенсируют от возможного разлёта частиц силы полевого происхождения.

doc_title_en: Physical properties of a flat varicap with an electron cluster
doc_title_ru: Физические свойства плоского варикапа с электронным кластером
statement_en: Fig. 2 shows schematically a plane capacitor with electron gas: metal plates 1-1 with distance d apart have area S; 2 denotes the charge cluster in the closed volume V = S·l from which electrons cannot exit; the bounded volume of electron gas forms inside the vacuum bulb thanks to the effect of electron clusterization discovered by Shoulders; electrons are supplied from a thin film of charges formed on the cathode surface; the strongly inhomogeneous field of the sharp cathode, by the gradient of its pressure (acting on the mass density of substance), dumps the charge film into the volume V always so that it, decreasing in volume, increases its volume charge density in the bubble.
quote_ru: Сильно неоднородное поле острийного катода градиентом своего давления (действует на массовую плотность вещества) сбрасывает плёнку зарядов в объём V всегда так, что она, уменьшаясь в объёме, увеличивает свою объёмную плотность зарядов в пузырьке.

cathode field pressure gradient compresses film into volume V raising charge density

doc_title_en: Physical properties of a flat varicap with an electron cluster
doc_title_ru: Физические свойства плоского варикапа с электронным кластером
statement_en: As shown in [4], two regimes of output of the electron film from the injector into vacuum are possible: with constant acceleration and with constant velocity; both regimes form charge clusters in the space between the cathode and the glass bulb which mix and fill the volume V in a finite time; the finally filled volume V is a cluster of macroscopic sizes holding all the electrons arrived from the source.
quote_ru: Оба режима формируют в пространстве между катодом и стеклянной колбой зарядовые кластеры, которые перемешиваются и заполняют объём V за конечное время. Окончательно заполненный объём V представляет собой кластер макроскопических размеров, удерживающий все электроны, пришедшие из источника.

doc_title_en: Physical properties of a flat varicap with an electron cluster
doc_title_ru: Физические свойства плоского варикапа с электронным кластером
statement_en: Under the external field E0 the electron cluster polarizes as shown in Fig. 3: E0 — direction of the external field lines, E' — response field of the electrons, E — resulting field strength in the cluster; σ0 — surface charge density on the capacitor plates, σ' — surface charge density of the response field; when one electron moves, a hole forms at its original place (a phenomenological object of solid-state physics with charge equal and opposite to the electron); the resulting field obeys superposition E = E' + E0 (1), projected on the x axis as E = E' − E0 (2), with the resulting field vector directed along x.
quote_ru: Тогда напряжённость результирующего поля E внутри области V подчиняется принципу суперпозиции

doc_title_en: Physical properties of a flat varicap with an electron cluster
doc_title_ru: Физические свойства плоского варикапа с электронным кластером
statement_en: The case considered is electrization of the electron gas in which the response-field strength E' created by the electrons is greater than the external field strength E0; when deriving the standard dielectric relations it is assumed that the response field formed by dipole molecules of a dielectric is always smaller than the external field; herein lies the most important physical difference between electrization of an electron gas and electrization of dipole molecules in an external electric field.
quote_ru: В этом и заключается важнейшее физическое отличие электризации газа электронов от электризации дипольных молекул во внешнем электрическом поле.

doc_title_en: Physical properties of a flat varicap with an electron cluster
doc_title_ru: Физические свойства плоского варикапа с электронным кластером
statement_en: Dividing (2) by the external field and introducing the dimensionless electrization parameter ε = E'/E0 > 1 (4), which shows how many times the field created by the electron cluster exceeds the external field strength; by plane symmetry the response field is related to the surface charge density by E' = σ'/ε₀ (5); correspondingly E/E0 = σ'/σ0 − 1 (6), where σ0 is the surface charge density of the capacitor plates.
quote_ru: Введём безразмерный параметр электризации газа электронов

doc_title_en: Physical properties of a flat varicap with an electron cluster
doc_title_ru: Физические свойства плоского варикапа с электронным кластером
statement_en: For the case when the surface density of the electron gas is much greater than the surface density of the charges on the capacitor plates, ε ≫ 1, and from (6) it follows that ε ≈ E/E0 (7), showing how many times the resulting field strength in the electron gas is greater than the field strength created by the capacitor plates.
quote_ru: Она показывает во сколько раз напряжённость результирующего поля в газе электронов больше, чем напряжённость поля, создаваемая обкладками конденсатора.

doc_title_en: Physical properties of a flat varicap with an electron cluster
doc_title_ru: Физические свойства плоского варикапа с электронным кластером
statement_en: Expressing the electrization parameter through the static capacitance of the plane capacitor gives ε = C/C0 (8), where C0 = ε₀S/d is the capacitance of the plates and C = q'/U0 the capacitance of the capacitor with the electron cluster, which depends on the external voltage on the plates; a voltage-dependent capacitance means the device is a varicap.
quote_ru: Зависящая от напряжения электроёмкость указывает на то, что это варикап.

doc_title_en: Physical properties of a flat varicap with an electron cluster
doc_title_ru: Физические свойства плоского варикапа с электронным кластером
statement_en: From (8) follows another physical meaning of the electrization parameter: it shows how many times the capacitance of the varicap with the electron cluster is greater than the capacitance of the varicap without the cluster; the value of this parameter coincides with the ratio of the electric energy of the internal capacitor W to the energy of the external capacitor.
quote_ru: Значение этого параметра совпадает с отношением электрической энергии внутреннего конденсатора W к энергии внешнего конденсатора.

doc_title_en: Physical properties of a flat varicap with an electron cluster
doc_title_ru: Физические свойства плоского варикапа с электронным кластером
statement_en: In the gas volume V there are N = ne·V electrons (9); the charge induced by the electrons on the whole plate is q' = η·e·ne·V (10), accounting that only a fraction η of the electrons of the whole cluster volume goes to the plates; the capacitance of the capacitor with the electron cluster is C = q'/U0 = ηC* (11) with the scale C* = e·ne·V/U0 (12), which also depends on the voltage on the plates; from (12) follows the most important property allowing the capacitance scale to be increased: the larger the volume of the electron cluster between the plates, the larger the capacitance.
quote_ru: Из (12) следует важнейшее свойство, позволяющее увеличивать масштаб ёмкости. Она тем больше, чем больше объём электронного кластера, находящегося между обкладками.

doc_title_en: Physical properties of a flat varicap with an electron cluster
doc_title_ru: Физические свойства плоского варикапа с электронным кластером
statement_en: From (11) it follows that the volume capacitance density of the varicap is CV = C/V = q'/(VU0) = ρ*/U0 = e·ne/U0 (13); at fixed external voltage it is larger the larger the scale of the volume charge density of the system.
quote_ru: При фиксированном значении внешнего напряжения она тем больше, чем больше масштаб объёмной плотности заряда.

doc_title_en: Physical properties of a flat varicap with an electron cluster
doc_title_ru: Физические свойства плоского варикапа с электронным кластером
statement_en: In a varicap with an electron cluster three charge-accumulation regimes are possible: in the first regime the electron concentration in the cluster is such that the effective charge q' = CU0 = const (14) (or the volume-density scale) on the plates of the volume V does not depend on the external voltage, and the varicap capacitance decreases inversely proportional to the external voltage; at high electron concentrations a second regime is possible where the volume charge-density scale depends linearly on the external voltage and the capacitance does not depend on the voltage; at ultrahigh concentrations a third accumulation regime is possible in which a bubble structure forms inside the electron cluster, giving the largest varicap capacitance, increasing proportionally to the external voltage.
quote_ru: В третьем режиме накопления ёмкость варикапа с пузырьками зарядов будет самая большая. Она будет увеличиваться пропорционально внешнему напряжению.

doc_title_ru: Физические свойства плоского варикапа с электронным кластером
statement_en: Approximate volt-farad characteristics of the three charge-accumulation regimes of the varicap are presented in Fig. 4; designations 1-2-3 correspond to the regime number.

doc_title_en: Physical properties of a flat varicap with an electron cluster
doc_title_ru: Физические свойства плоского варикапа с электронным кластером
statement_en: The Coulomb interaction forces between the electrons of the cluster are attractive; the charge system is balanced by the forces of field origin discovered by V. Sapogin, which act on the mass density of the electron cluster and hold the cluster inside the vacuum diode with removed anode from collapse.
quote_ru: Кулоновские силы взаимодействия между электронами кластера притягивающие. Уравновешивают систему зарядов силы полевого происхождения, обнаруженные В.Сапогиным [2]. doc_title_en: Electrical instability of the formation of flat electron clusters in a two-component plasma
doc_title_ru: Электрическая неустойчивость к формированию плоских электронных кластеров в двухкомпонентной плазме
statement_en: Over the last thirty years experiments on passing powerful short electric pulses through various conducting media were carried out in physical laboratories of many countries: the group of P.I. Golubnichiy observed long-lived glowing objects (LLO) of millimeter radii in purified water; G.D. statement_en: An approximate physical-mathematical model of plasmoid generation in a two-component plasma adequately describing their observed electrical properties is proposed; the study of static solutions of the model indicates the possibility of three kinds of plasmoids: electrically neutral, positively charged (electron cluster in hole plasma), or negatively charged (electron cluster in electron plasma); the study of nonstatic solutions at the initial stage indicates the possibility of two kinds of electrical instability: slow-wave instability and fast-wave instability.
quote_ru: Исследование статических решений модели указывает на возможность существования трёх видов плазмоидов: электронейтрального и заряженного положительно (электронный кластер в дырочной плазме), либо отрицательно (электронный кластер в электронной плазме).

statement_en: Formation of an electron cluster in hole plasma occurs in the presence of a seed field y ~ +sh(2γξ): at slow-wave instability the main part of the electrons starts moving toward the ξ = 0 plane, while at fast-wave instability the main part starts leaving for the periphery; formation of a plasmoid in the form of an electron cluster in electron plasma occurs for seed field y ~ −sh(2γξ): at slow-wave instability the main share of electrons leaves for the periphery, while at fast-wave instability the main share starts moving toward the ξ = 0 plane.
quote_ru: Образование электронного кластера в дырочной плазме происходит при наличии затравочного поля y ~  sh( 2 ) . При неустойчивости на медленных волнах основная часть электронов начинает движение к плоскости ξ=0, а при реализации неустойчивости на быстрых волнах основная часть электронов начинает уходить на периферию.  Образование плазмоида в виде электронного кластера в электронной плазме происходит для затравочного поля y ~ sh( 2 ) .

statement_en: The conservation law makes it possible to understand what compensates the Coulomb interaction in the statics: as the analytical study shows, the Coulomb interaction is compensated by the Bernoulli force; the compensation of forces leads to a new physics following from the conservation law: the charge concentration (pressure) is greater where the self-consistent field pressure is greater, and vice versa; a similar result appeared in Pustovoyt's solutions — where the square of the tangent is greater (near the system asymptotes) the charge pressure is greater; the author's results entered the monograph [4] published in 2000 in Taganrog.

doc_title_en: Emden gas balls in the self-consistent theory of gravitation
doc_title_ru: Газовые шары Эмдена в самосогласованной теории гравитации
statement_en: The self-consistent gravity theory rests on five postulates: (1) there exists a class of collective interaction between gravitating particles in which the macroscopic self-consistent gravitational field acts back on the particles that generate it; (2) this back-action always creates a retaining volume density of static field-origin forces tied to the self-consistent field pressure gradient and co-directed with it; (3) the system is in static equilibrium with its field when the pressure gradients of field and particles are equal in magnitude and opposite in direction in every elementary volume; (4) in plane dynamical accumulations the zero sum of the pressure gradients yields a conservation law for the scalar total-pressure function (field plus particle pressures) playing the role of the interaction Hamiltonian; (5) the equilibrium condition contradicts neither Gauss's theorem nor Earnshaw's theorem, which apply to systems of fixed point particles with only Newtonian (or Coulomb) forces and no field-origin volume forces.
quote_ru: существует такой класс коллективного взаимодействия между гравитирующими частицами динамической системы

doc_title_en: Emden gas balls in the self-consistent theory of gravitation
doc_title_ru: Газовые шары Эмдена в самосогласованной теории гравитации
statement_en: The authors characterize self-consistent statics: distribution functions from power-law to Boltzmann; first-kind states hold particles in potential wells (concentration maximal at the potential-energy minimum), second-kind states concentrate particles at the bottom of a slot; in spherically symmetric first-kind states there exists a sphere of zero field pressure (also zero collective field strength) dividing the cluster matter into inner and outer atmospheres with field directed outward inside and inward outside; for any state parameters the matter concentration tends to zero at the ball center, contradicting the Lane-Emden boundary conditions (maximal central density), which therefore had to be revised; in cold first-kind states a cavity forms where matter is practically absent and the ball becomes a bubble; potential energy is defined up to a constant and can take either sign.
quote_ru: Отличительные особенности самосогласованной стати- ки.

statement_en: The authors show there are three variants of inelastic impact of a hollow cluster on a flat surface (large, medium, weak energy release); after impact the hollow gravitational cluster (matter in a thin layer) leaves a characteristic crater whose texture depends on the critical surface density of particles above which the surface material melts; large release gives a frozen circular melt pad ringed by squeezed-out material, medium release melts only the crater rim forming a ring of finite thickness and radius, weak release leaves no crater; the characteristic ring-shaped melted crater with rim forms when a thin-wall, very hot bubble falls from space.

statement_en: The base equations of self-consistent gravitational statics generalize Lane and Emden with a Frenkel-style approach: equilibrium of an elementary volume rho*g + f = 0; div g = -4*pi*G*rho; g = -grad(phi); equations of state p = rho*k*T/m (uniform temperature) or p = K*rho^n (polytropic); f = -grad(p) defining the gas-hydrostatic Bernoulli force; the truncated system reduces to the Lane-Emden equation for density in polytropic states.

statement_en: For a hollow spherical cluster (radii r2 > r1, uniform concentration, particle-number conservation, perpendicular impact) the transformation of volume concentration n into surface density on the impacted plane is sigma(rho) = 2n*(sqrt(r2^2-rho^2) - sqrt(r1^2-rho^2)); normalized with eta = r1/r2 and chi = rho/r1 the distribution sigma_n = (sqrt(1-eta^2*chi^2) - eta*sqrt(1-chi^2))/(1-eta) for 0<=chi<=1 and sigma_n = sqrt(1-eta^2*chi^2)/(1-eta) for 1<=chi<=1/eta; the surface density of incident particles has a strong radial inhomogeneity near chi ~ 1 (adjacent to the cavity radius): the maximum falls on r1 and vanishes at r2; the melt region depends on the critical surface density sigma_k above which the surface material melts.
quote_ru: Тогда преобразование концентрации частиц n в поверхно- стную плотность

statement_en: The author lists seven observed properties of the Tunguska phenomenon: (1) an unidentified object fell from space at about 40 km/s; (2) astronomers did not detect its motion in near-Earth space before the fall; (3) the object measured roughly 5 to 25 km in diameter by various estimates, and some witnesses hold there were two objects; (4) its atmospheric passage excited powerful light, sound and electromagnetic waves that circled the Earth several times; (5) high atmospheric activity was observed a day or two before the fall (precursors); (6) the impact produced the "mast forest" and taiga fall over many kilometers, with no characteristic meteorite crater; (7) two-three years after the fall the catastrophe traces disappeared; the author also notes a similar smaller body fell in the Krasnoyarsk taiga in 2004.
quote_ru: Итак, выделим важнейшие наблюдаемые свойства Тунгус- ского феномена:

statement_en: The author asserts that gravitational clusters, being a collective phenomenon, cannot arise singly: like Shoulders charge clusters they appear as a chain of similar objects of diverse masses during explosive catastrophes in space — the proposed answer to observed properties 3 and 5 of the Tunguska phenomenon (several objects may have fallen); these objects are invisible (emit and reflect practically nothing), making a space watch service problematic.

statement_en: The author states that dozens of expeditions visited the Tunguska catastrophe site over the hundred years since the fall, more than a hundred scientific hypotheses of its origin have been proposed, and the mainstream of physicists and astronomers holds it was the collision of a small comet with Earth; comet nuclei are small icy bodies becoming visible only within 4-5 AU of the Sun, with diameters 0.5-50 km and, at ice density 800 kg/m3, masses from 5e7 to 5e13 tons.

doc_title_en: Gradient electron injector of a field-emission cathode with angular aperture
doc_title_ru: Градиентный электронный инжектор автоэмиссионного катода с угловой апертурой
statement_en: The authors report that the huge classical field strengths for autoemission are not required: they dropped to 20-70 V/um (determined experimentally), and the current densities obtained in Shoulders experiments lay in the range 10^4 to 10^8 A/cm2, so a 1 cm2 cathode would deliver a mean current of a million amperes with no heating; one can draw from the fountain-like autoemission cathode as many electrons as the external source supplies.
quote_ru: Приводимые выше, огромные значения напряжённости электрических полей уже не требуются. Они уменьшились до значений от 20 до 70 В/мкм

doc_title_en: Gradient electron injector of a field-emission cathode with angular aperture
doc_title_ru: Градиентный электронный инжектор автоэмиссионного катода с угловой апертурой
statement_en: The authors describe Mesyats group explosive thermoemission experiments: rapid supply of a high concentration of thermal energy to the cathode causes explosions in small protrusion regions ("ectons") that throw out avalanche-formed portions of electrons; in his dissertation the author calculated the charge of one ejected portion from those data and found the electron counts fall in the range Shoulders indicated for EV — evidence both groups encountered the same phenomenon of charge-cluster formation near a metal surface.
quote_ru: В экспериментах Месяца к катоду быстро подводилась высокая концентрация тепловой энергии.
geometry: шероховатости катода в виде острийных образований

doc_title_en: Gradient electron injector of a field-emission cathode with angular aperture
doc_title_ru: Градиентный электронный инжектор автоэмиссионного катода с угловой апертурой
statement_en: The authors analyze the Shoulders triode: the tip cathode to control-electrode distance was of order a micrometer, making the external field strongly transversely inhomogeneous; the field both thickens the electron "coat" and produces a volume force density (field-pressure gradient) pushing the thin electron layer toward smaller collective-interaction forces; the control electrode plays the key role (acting as the anode forming the electron injector), while the triode anode and screen electrode are auxiliary and may be omitted — leaving a main accumulator forming a vacuum-capacitor-like storage device.
quote_ru: А в триоде Шоулдерса (см. рис.1) расстояние между острийным катодом и управляющим электродом было порядка микрометра.
geometry: tip cathode to control electrode gap of order 1 micrometer

doc_title_en: Gradient electron injector of a field-emission cathode with angular aperture
doc_title_ru: Градиентный электронный инжектор автоэмиссионного катода с угловой апертурой
statement_en: The authors report that the highest autoemission current density of the Spindt cathode is achieved when the cathode tip is level with the molybdenum control-electrode diaphragm film, where the field-pressure gradient in the gap is maximal, arising near the top of the tip.
quote_ru: Исследования показали, что наибольшее значение плотности автоэмиссионного тока достигается в том случае, когда острие катода
geometry: tip level with control-electrode diaphragm plane

doc_title_en: Gradient electron injector of a field-emission cathode with angular aperture
doc_title_ru: Градиентный электронный инжектор автоэмиссионного катода с угловой апертурой
statement_en: The authors tabulate (Table 1) the Spindt cathode parameters: base area of tip cathode Sk = 0.2 um2; tip curvature radius R = 50 nm; current-filament area S = 0.4 um2; nominal working current I = 50-150 uA; current density J = 2-8 A/cm2 at nominal regime; pulling field E = 70-200 V/um; required technical vacuum P = 1e-9 mm Hg; time to accumulate 1 C in a vacuum storage by one cathode at 100 uA = 2.8 h, by a 100-emitter matrix at 5 mA = 3.4 min; full emission area S_e = 0.0625 mm2; emitter packing density 1600 per cm2 (100-emitter array) and 640,000 per cm2 (5000-emitter array).
quote_ru: Исследования показали, что наибольшее значение плотности

doc_title_en: Gradient electron injector of a field-emission cathode with angular aperture
doc_title_ru: Градиентный электронный инжектор автоэмиссионного катода с угловой апертурой
statement_en: The authors assert that K. Shoulders, after leaving Stanford, discovered in the 1980s on his tip cathodes a new physical object named Electrum Validum (EV) or charge cluster (ZK), and that in his monograph he solved a set of experimental problems: ZK generation, measurement of their physical and geometric parameters, orientation of their motion, separation from each other, and interaction with metal surfaces and waves; he worked with uncoated metal tip cathodes.
quote_ru: Кен Шоулдерс в своей монографии

doc_title_en: Gradient electron injector of a field-emission cathode with angular aperture
doc_title_ru: Градиентный электронный инжектор автоэмиссионного катода с угловой апертурой
statement_en: The authors interpret Shoulders crater experiments: the ZK striking flat titanium at an angle leaves a melt crater approximating a ring shape, indicating the cluster contains a charge-free region like a soap bubble; at impact the charge-distribution function of the incident cluster transforms into the distribution of excess-energy release density on the surface, so normal incidence gives a circular melt region and oblique incidence an ellipse; in its usual state the charge cluster is a spherical shell with a cavity — a bubble of electrons.
quote_ru: Поясню, не до конца понятые многими читателями, моменты в проведённых экспериментах Шоулдерса.

doc_title_en: Gradient electron injector of a field-emission cathode with angular aperture
doc_title_ru: Градиентный электронный инжектор автоэмиссионного катода с угловой апертурой
statement_en: The authors assert that an elementary volume of charges of either sign in a cluster is held by two oppositely directed forces: the electric force directed along the field-strength vector (for positive charges) acting on the charge density, and a Bernoulli-like gasostatic force directed against the self-consistent field-pressure gradient acting on the mass density; these retention conditions explain why Earnshaw's theorem (formulated for point charges with dominant Coulomb interaction) does not apply, and imply any extended like-charged bunch in an external field always feels two forces — electric and gasostatic — whose directions depend on the field and gradient directions and on the orientation of the bunch axis.
quote_ru: элементарный объём зарядов любого знака в кластере удерживается двумя противоположно направленными силами.

doc_title_en: Gradient electron injector of a field-emission cathode with angular aperture
doc_title_ru: Градиентный электронный инжектор автоэмиссионного катода с угловой апертурой
statement_en: The authors discuss the Biefeld-Brown effect (1921): Coulomb attraction forces of two or more bodies may be unequal, giving an asymmetric capacitor a net force directed from the negative to the positive electrode that changes its weight depending on orientation at high voltage; Frolov's experiments showed the dielectric elasticity matters, which the authors explain by an additional field-pressure-gradient force acting on the mass density of the dielectric.
quote_ru: Несколько слов об электрогравитационных аппаратах Томаса Таунсенда Брауна.

doc_title_en: Gradient electron injector of a field-emission cathode with angular aperture
doc_title_ru: Градиентный электронный инжектор автоэмиссионного катода с угловой апертурой
statement_en: The authors extend the two-force interaction to gravitation: any extended volume of gravitating masses in an external gravitational field feels the gravitational force and a gasostatic force tied to the external field pressure gradient, both acting on mass density; on this assumption a self-consistent theory of gravity (continuing Emden's gas-sphere studies) is built, from which the Tunguska phenomenon was a hollow loose cosmic snowball of nanoscale ice dust (minimal destruction in the epicenter, "mast forest" per Kulik 1921 expedition, forest flattened over 30 km outside); Enceladus ice geysers are proposed as the snowball source, and the two-force mechanism pumping work into elastic deformation via Hooke's law explains the geological activity of Saturn's and Jupiter's satellites and sustains Earth's tectonic activity.
quote_ru: Такое же, двухсиловое, взаимодействие существует и при гравитационном взаимодействии протяжённых тел.

doc_title_en: Gradient electron injector of a field-emission cathode with angular aperture
doc_title_ru: Градиентный электронный инжектор автоэмиссионного катода с угловой апертурой
statement_en: The authors assert that the charge and field system inside a charge cluster is strongly inhomogeneous at its boundary: on the outer and inner surfaces of a spherical cluster the electron concentration grows above the average concentration in a solid, which explains its unusual behavior in solids — it can drill through the crystal lattice and absorb the formed gaseous substance; this also explains why Shoulders had to frequently replace worn tip cathodes (clusters cut the conical surface like a file), and warns that a ZK is dangerous to hold in HV-ceramic storage: at large stored energies it can display ball-lightning properties, freely passing through glass obstacles.
quote_ru: Из изложенного выше ясно, что система зарядов и полей внутри зарядового кластера обладают сильной неоднородностью.
geometry: elevated surface electron concentration on outer and inner cluster surfaces

doc_title_en: Gradient electron injector of a field-emission cathode with angular aperture
doc_title_ru: Градиентный электронный инжектор автоэмиссионного катода с угловой апертурой
statement_en: The authors assert (conclusion 2) that a plane-electrode system cannot serve as an electron injector: the field pressure is uniform, the pressure gradient is zero everywhere between the plates, so it exerts no action on the electron coat, which collective forces hold at the cathode; a plane capacitor field is also technically unrealizable — any plate skew produces a pressure gradient that drives the electron coat across the field direction and discharges to the positive electrode over the dielectric surface (high-voltage breakdown of plane capacitors).
quote_ru: система плоских электродов не может быть использована в качестве конструкции инжектора электронов.

doc_title_en: Gradient electron injector of a field-emission cathode with angular aperture
doc_title_ru: Градиентный электронный инжектор автоэмиссионного катода с угловой апертурой
statement_en: The authors describe the cylindrical diode: the field strength E_r decreases as 1/r, the field pressure D as 1/r2, and the pressure gradient G as 1/r3 directed against r; the force opposite the gradient acts on the electron coat stretching it radially; both forces only slightly thicken the coat and without cathode heating cannot fill the cathode-anode distance (indirect heating fills the gap up to 5 mm).
quote_ru: ещё быстрее, чем давление поля, как 1/r3. Градиент давления направлен против оси r.
quantities: заполнение промежутка до 5 мм при накале

doc_title_en: Gradient electron injector of a field-emission cathode with angular aperture
doc_title_ru: Градиентный электронный инжектор автоэмиссионного катода с угловой апертурой
statement_en: The authors describe the experimentally studied configuration based on the vacuum diode 1Ts21P with an additional anode insulated in ceramics: a strongly inhomogeneous field region arises near the end of the axisymmetric cathode where a bundle of field lines enters perpendicular to the cathode equipotential; the field-pressure gradient points along the axis toward the cathode, so the force on the electron coat points to the anode and adds to the electric force — both throw electrons to the anode, explaining the detected charge-accumulation effect (largest accumulated charge near the ceramic-insulated anode).
quote_ru: Эта конфигурация должна давать самый большой накопленный заряд вблизи анода с керамикой.

doc_title_en: Gradient electron injector of a field-emission cathode with angular aperture
doc_title_ru: Градиентный электронный инжектор автоэмиссионного катода с угловой апертурой
statement_en: The proposed gradient electron injector with angular aperture: the cathode plate lies in the plane phi = 0 and the anode plate is symmetrically rotated by the aperture angle theta; distances from the z axis to the near parts of the plates are R1 and to the far parts R2; field lines are bounded circle arcs; the potential depends only on the angle and the approximate Laplace solution phi = C1*phi_angle + C2 gives a single field component E_phi decreasing as 1/r, with scales U* = U/theta, E* = U*/R1, U = E*R1*theta, D* = eps0*E*^2/2, G* = eps0*E*^2/R1 = 2D*/R1; the force f opposite the gradient pulls the electron coat toward increasing r where the drift space and electron accumulator should be placed.
quote_ru: На рис. 8 представлен схематично инжектор с угловой апертурой в полярных координатах

doc_title_en: Gradient electron injector of a field-emission cathode with angular aperture
doc_title_ru: Градиентный электронный инжектор автоэмиссионного катода с угловой апертурой
statement_en: The authors derive two regimes of charge output from the aperture injector for a planar bunch of thickness d, width H, length R2-R1, cross-section S = Hd: (1) accelerated motion of an incompressible layer center of mass with scales a* = D*/(m*n0*R2), v* = E*sqrt(eps0/(m*n0)), tau* = 2*sqrt(m*n0/eps0)/E*, current-density scale j* = e*E**sqrt(eps0*n0/m), ohmic resistance R* = (theta*R1/(e*d*H))*sqrt(m/(n0*eps0)) independent of voltage — a linear volt-ampere characteristic; (2) viscous motion with volume-reduced viscosity mu giving stationary speed v_c = (D*/(mu*R2))*(1+R1/R2), current-density scale j* = e*n0*D*/(mu*R2), resistance scale R* = 2*mu*R1*R2*theta/(e*eps0*n0*E**d*H) — a quadratic volt-ampere characteristic; the regimes differ by hundreds of times, indicating the Shoulders triode and Spindt cathode operated in different output regimes.
quote_ru: О двух режимах вывода зарядов из инжектора

statement_en: Scientific novelty item 1: a method is proposed for the equilibrium of a collisionless dynamic charge system in two-flow or one-flow motion with a plane static self-consistent field, showing the equilibrium distributions are determined both by the collisionless distribution function and by the Hamiltonian function representing the total pressure of the system; distribution laws of velocities, pressures, potential, field strength and charges are found for states with positive, zero and negative total pressures; the physics of charge retention by the self-consistent field is substantiated; the geometric length of the system is determined for nonnegative total pressure, the charge motion period in the interaction space is computed, and in states with negative total pressure a charge self-acceleration effect is discovered.
quote_ru: 1. Предложен метод решения задач равновесия динамической бес- столкновительной системы зарядов

doc_title_en: Author's abstract (Mechanisms of matter retention by a self-consistent field)
doc_title_ru: Автореферат (Механизмы удержания вещества самосогласованным полем)
statement_en: Scientific novelty items 2-4: for polytropic states the system distributions are determined by the power-law distribution function and the total pressure, with spatial laws of potential, field strength, temperature, volume retention forces, field and charge pressures, and the geometric length of the bounded system depending on the state parameter and polytropic temperature; for constant temperature the distributions are determined by the Boltzmann function and the total-pressure function, with the retention mechanism substantiated and system sizes found for negative total pressure; for thermodiffusion systems with distributed heat sinks the distributions depend on two integrals — the scalar total-pressure integral and a vector integral representing the total field-strength vector of the system, composed of the difference of the effective thermodiffusion field strength and the self-consistent field strength.
quote_ru: 4. Получены распределения физических величин равновесий зарядов с плоским полем для систем с термодиффузией

statement_en: Chapter 1 reviews the static self-consistent field methods (Lane, Emden, Ritter), Laue's work on thermoelectron equilibrium near electrodes of different geometry showing the Laue and Emden density equations have identical structure differing only in the sign of the right-hand side, Vlasov's general method of constructing self-consistent equilibria accounting for interactions of moving charged particles, and Frenkel's independent introduction of the same field-calculation methods for gravitating and like-charge systems (self-consistent fields); the review of modern charge- and current-cluster works includes an estimate of the mean charge in an ecton matching the upper value of electrons recorded in EV, indicating an ecton can be an EV source.

statement_en: Numerical modeling of the thermodiffusion system at heat-sink efficiency coefficient delta = 1/2 and state parameter beta = 1/2 shows: (1) the length of positive-total-pressure states is bounded for the total field-strength parameter satisfying -infinity < alpha < 0.5, with decreasing alpha increasing the temperature gradient at x=0 and thinning the charge layer; (2) at the system boundary the absolute temperature and pressure vanish; (3) the concentration distribution has a sharp boundary — for alpha = -0.25 and -0.5 it vanishes at the boundary, for alpha = -0.75 and -1.0 the distribution law changes with unlimited concentration growth at the boundary (the growing temperature gradient moves more charges to the outer boundary); (4) a heat flux exists whose density direction depends on alpha (along x for -infinity < alpha < 0.5, against x for alpha > 0.75); (5) within -2 < alpha < 0.5 the system length with thermodiffusion increases 12-fold.

statement_en: For the spherical cluster with alpha^2 >> 1 (cold cluster), the approximate solution of the radial equilibrium equation for boundary conditions x=1, y(1)=0, y'(1)=0 (implying a zero-field-pressure sphere) is q*phi/(2kT) = ln[(alpha*r/R)/sqrt(alpha^2-1) * sin(A)] with A = arcsin(sqrt(alpha^2-1)/alpha) - ln(r/R)*sqrt(alpha^2-1); the self-consistent field potential of positive cluster charges is negative in all space with a maximum on the zero-field-pressure sphere, which divides the space into inner and outer atmospheres; the volume-force distributions computed from the solution show expanding forces co-directed with E and the charge pressure gradient, compensated by forces created by the field pressure gradient taken with opposite sign, so the main part of cluster charges is held near the system boundaries in deep potential wells creating high-concentration layers able to mechanically destroy solid surfaces; the zeros of the sine give asymptotes bounding the interaction space and indicating an internal cavity with no charges; the layer thickness is d = r2 - r1 = pi*R/alpha = pi*k*T/(q*sqrt(2*pi*n0)); already at state parameter alpha = 3.0 a cavity arises in the cluster.

statement_en: The defended theory rests on fundamental provisions: (1) there exists a class of collective interaction between like charges in which the macroscopic self-consistent field acts back on the charges generating it; (2) this back-action always creates a retaining volume density of hydro-aerostatic field-origin forces tied to the self-consistent field pressure gradient, equal to it in magnitude and opposite in direction; (3) the dynamic charge system is in hydrostatic equilibrium with its field when the field and charge pressure gradients are equal in every elementary volume; (4) the equality of pressure gradients in plane dynamic accumulations for any equation of state, and in collisionless cases, yields a conservation law of the scalar total-pressure integral composed of the DIFFERENCE of field and charge pressures playing the role of the interaction Hamiltonian; (5) the equilibrium condition does not contradict Earnshaw's theorem, which is formulated for a system of fixed charges with only Coulomb forces and no volume hydrostatic field-origin forces.

statement_en: The conclusion introduces the "surface current of excess charges" enabling a non-quantum explanation of autoelectron emission: at room temperatures an excess-charge atmosphere always exists in the near-cathode region of a vacuum diode (fed by a small number of thermoelectrons plus charges from an external accelerating field); raising the cathode-anode voltage increases the atmosphere height via two factors — more excess charges maintain the arising displacement current, and the external electrostatic field elastically deforms the atmosphere height; at a threshold external-field strength the atmosphere height reaches the cathode-anode distance and the current must arise jump-wise at atmosphere-anode contact, whereas the quantum model of autoelectron emission has no threshold field values or current jumps.

statement_en: The conclusion lists further promising charge-cluster applications: straight-through microwave generators in which spreading bunched electron bunches are replaced by charge clusters — a new class of microwave devices with output power significantly exceeding modern klystrons, traveling-wave and backward-wave tubes; explosions of a non-radiated cluster can generate gamma quanta; the greatest effort should go to nonlinear interaction of charge clusters with the wall of a metal resonator where an image charge arises; the discovered elastic deformation of the excess-charge atmosphere thickness sensitive to temperature gradient allows microwave oscillation generators on a new physical principle — a vacuum diode in the no-current mode placed in a resonator tuned to the atmosphere-height oscillation frequency will generate oscillations whose frequency depends on the cathode temperature gradient and the external electric field, attractive for a new generation of micron-size solid-state vacuum electronics.

statement_en: The dissertation introduction credits Lane, Ritter, Kelvin, Emden and Fowler with the fundamental contribution to the gravitational-equilibrium problem whose solution methods were the first step toward a universal calculation method for static macroscopic self-consistent fields; the imposed density requirement (no increase from center to surface) restricted accepted configurations to those where the gravitational field vector and radius vector are opposite, with other solutions discarded as extraneous because their fields violate the Gauss theorem; the mathematical equilibrium condition does not reveal the physical retention cause, which chapter 7 ties to a compensating force connected with the field pressure gradient, equal to it in magnitude and direction; the thermoelectron equilibrium equation in spherical coordinates differs from the Emden E-equation only by the right-hand-side sign (attraction replaced by like-charge repulsion), and the image-charge potential does not enter the equation nor influence its solutions, leaving the retention condition and force nature unexplained in that approach.

statement_en: The dissertation summarizes Vlasov's collective-interaction theory as resting on two physical premises: (1) rejection of the principle of spatial and velocity localization of a particle (in the classical-mechanics sense) independent of force interactions; (2) introduction of force interactions by analogy with classical mechanics but accounting for the new non-localization principle; their mathematical realization leads to a system describing two particles interacting via central forces and electromagnetically.

statement_en: The author explains the frequency growth of rolled ribbon-microsolenoid inductance by the increase of the linear current density in the ribbon — possible only if the AC forms a thin cord whose diameter becomes smaller than the ribbon width; as the frequency approaches the cutoff the cord "disappears" and the solenoid loses its inductive properties; cord thinning at microwave frequencies is explained via the forces retaining the cylindrical cord: with frequency growth the external source injects fewer like charges per half-period, lowering the volume density of Coulomb repulsion, while the volume density of constricting (Ampere) forces stays constant or falls more slowly; the cutoff frequency is when the cord catastrophically collapses into a pinch, where the inductance of a single inductor rises sharply and then the solenoid loses its inductive properties.

statement_en: The author cites the key 2001 experimental work of Kuhn and Ibrahim: studying current flow at high frequencies in single multi-turn square, rectangular and spiral inductors they discovered an effect directly opposite to the skin effect — AC at gigahertz frequencies formed a spatially localized current cord in the conductor of an inductor of any geometry; with frequency growth the cord decreased its cross-section, so the ohmic resistance and inductance of the inductor grew with frequency and the AC flow no longer obeyed Ohm's law.

doc_title_ru: Интегральные индуктивности с высокой симметрией
statement_en: The author classifies current inductors by field-line geometry into closed and open: closed — classical finite-length solenoids whose internal mean magnetic field-line density is always higher than outside; placing nanoscale-thin films transverse to the field lines inside can substantially raise the positive inductance, produce frequency-independent inductance and raise the cutoff, while thick or multilayer films can create dynamic-inductance states with positive values different from the original solenoid inductance; filling the whole solenoid space with a conductor gives the maximal negative introduced inductance, and the solenoid-rod system inductance always remains reduced but positive; open — planar spirals with symmetric field lines in both half-spaces: a nanoscale film on one side raises the total positive inductance (frequency-independent), two identical films on both sides raise it further, and a thick or multilayer film on one or both sides gives negative frequency-dependent dynamic inductance growing proportionally to the layer count, with single-turn current rings increasing the achievable volume inductance density.

doc_title_en: Integrated inductances with high symmetry

statement_en: Limit estimates for analog microcircuitry: in a layer 1 mm thick with 1 cm2 area one can place 16,000 inductors in 40 layers, creating a positive macroinductance at the 1 mH level, with the negative-inductance value an order higher; the prospect technology "conducting film in a current ring" operating in the nanoscale Foucault-eddy-current effect regime can integrate ~10 nH inductances (per layer up to 500 nm thick) in microchips, while the 10-30 double-layer branch yields passive negative inductances with extremely high volume density of about -2.0e7 H/m3; a seven-step experimental program is proposed: master multilayer film processes per the Ohio work, replicate Al-Cu results from two to 30 layers, verify the nanoscale positive eddy-current inductance effect in a single film, show the film inductance dependence on geometry, investigate independence of film inductance from resistivity, determine the film frequency-range vs resistivity dependence, and demonstrate dynamic eddy-current inductance on a thick single-layer film with the minimal negative value frequency dependence.

doc_title_en: Mechanisms of matter retention by a self-consistent field
doc_title_ru: Механизмы удержания вещества самосогласованным полем
statement_en: The author argues that charging a thin-walled metal sphere must create two charge "atmospheres" — internal and external — each with its own height depending on temperature, surface curvature radius and the imparted charge (isotropy principle of Coulomb-force directions); analogous atmospheres form on a flat isolated plate; experiments with a "tunneling" microscope are reinterpreted: current arises when the excess-charge atmosphere on the tip (conical geometry) touches the opposite-sign charge atmosphere of the substrate, and the measured height of the external atmosphere on a tip lies in the range of several micrometers.
quote_ru: В этом случае должны образоваться две “атмосферы” − внутренняя и внешняя, каждая со своей высотой.

doc_title_en: Mechanisms of matter retention by a self-consistent field
doc_title_ru: Механизмы удержания вещества самосогласованным полем
statement_en: The author analyzes Cavendish-type experiments (removable hemispherical shell over a charged ball): high-precision experiments showed zero residual charge on the ball, which he explains by the removed shell not leaving its internal charge atmosphere on the ball; the internal atmosphere height under the same conditions is less than the external one — fractions of a micrometer — and cannot be detected by any gross mechanical or electric measurements; due to Coulomb interaction the charge concentration in the external atmosphere grows outward and in the internal atmosphere inward; for large negative charges the concentration near the internal cavity can reach or exceed the mean electron concentration of the solid, giving the atmosphere the hardness of metal.
quote_ru: Эксперименты с высокой точностью показали, что остающийся на шаре заряд равен нулю.
procedure_steps: charge a ball with a snug removable conductive shell
remove the shell with insulating handles
measure the residual ball charge

doc_title_en: Mechanisms of matter retention by a self-consistent field
doc_title_ru: Механизмы удержания вещества самосогласованным полем
statement_en: The author states that none of the four known interactions (gravitational, strong, weak, electromagnetic) can clarify the oldest paradox of experimental electrostatics — what compensates Coulomb repulsion of the excess charge once it has formed a surface atmosphere; nuclear forces act at 1e-15 m and cannot explain micron charge atmospheres; he quotes Matveev's 1983 textbook remark that electrostatics does not study why surface charges do not leave the conductor and the nature of the retaining forces, and notes two opposite unsubstantiated views exist, with the second admitting autonomous bounded systems of excess charges — charge clusters (ZK) studied for the last 20 years, with experimental discovery priority belonging to K. Shoulders.
quote_ru: Ни одно из них не может прояснить самый древний парадокс экс- периментальной электростатики.

doc_title_en: Mechanisms of matter retention by a self-consistent field
doc_title_ru: Механизмы удержания вещества самосогласованным полем
statement_en: The author summarizes EV (Elektrum Validum) properties per Shoulders: EVs form under a strong field of 2 to 10 kV between cathode and anode, are small (fractions to tens of micrometers) and carry a large electron charge (1e8 to 1e11 electrons per sphere); individual EVs are rare — they usually form ring-like structures about 20 um in diameter consisting of EV chains; the mean EV lifetime is about 30 ps, for whose observation a special picoscope with 0.1 ps resolution was built; the mean electron concentration in EV is 6.6e23 cm-3, an order above the mean electron concentration of solids, and without a crystal lattice EV shows the hardness of diamond abrasive — given a channel smaller than its diameter it drills a wider one, and its passage through a film leaves a hole with burnt edges; pulsed EV generation at the tip cathode quickly wears its surface; EV flow interaction with a radioactive substrate reduces its radioactivity; EVs moving through gas are accompanied by a visible stream of particles (streamer) preceded by a narrow beam of light; EV decay releases energy as X-rays or explodes upon reaching a critically low charge density.
quote_ru: EV, образующиеся при создании сильного (от 2 до 10 кВ) электри- ческого поля между катодом и анодом, имеют малые размеры

doc_title_ru: Механизмы удержания вещества самосогласованным полем
statement_en: The author reports Shoulders' own explanation of ZK properties, based on the concept of a polarized vacuum possessing zero-point oscillation energy: Shoulders asserted the initial electron motion at EV formation is maintained in equilibrium or even compressed by zero-point oscillation energy, and that EV is a perfect spherical generator built on an asymmetric vibrator exciting vector and scalar longitudinal waves without electric or magnetic fields; no quantitative relations allowing EV calculation are given, which the author criticizes as narrow-professional jargon, arguing part of the ZK properties coincide with those of excess-charge atmospheres — evidence of the same physical nature of the retaining forces and of an unknown property of collective charge interaction manifesting only at high concentration.

statement_en: The author proposes constructing an unusual object: charge a thin-walled isolated metal sphere in vacuum of radius 5 to 10 cm with a negative charge four-five orders above the largest EV charge; after micron charge atmospheres form, mentally remove the sphere — under the retaining forces the atmospheres converge and a charge cluster arises with energy in the range 10 to 230 kJ; the object is lighter than a dust mote (no heavier than 1e-14 kg), can float freely in the atmosphere moving with air flows and act on surrounding metal objects as a charged body; its moving electrons radiate electromagnetic waves in a wide frequency range, heating adjacent atmosphere; irreversible contact losses guarantee decay — in some cases radiation with silent disappearance, in others an explosion upon reaching critical charge-concentration loss; similar objects often arise during thunderstorms and in experiments modeling large currents in gas atmospheres.

doc_title_en: Mechanisms of matter retention by a self-consistent field
doc_title_ru: Механизмы удержания вещества самосогласованным полем
statement_en: The conclusion highlights: in the spherical case an internal charge atmosphere exists whose concentration grows toward the system center; it forms inside a thin-walled metal sphere carrying negative excess charge, with height from thousandths to hundreds of micrometers depending on accumulated charge, temperature and radius; the high-concentration layer has metal properties and should reflect coherent radiation well — interferometric methods with visible-light wavelengths are sensitive enough to measure the height dependence on the imparted charge; glowing ball-shaped charge clusters have long been observed in high-current experiments in various media (first glowing balls in a Leyden-jar discharge; long-lived glowing objects in liquids); in unpublished MRTI experiments a high-current cylindrical electron beam output into a gas atmosphere turned into glowing balls with lifetimes sufficient for visualization, and the retention mechanism explains static states of glowing balls in any media from a unified viewpoint.

doc_title_en: Mechanisms of matter retention by a self-consistent field
doc_title_ru: Механизмы удержания вещества самосогласованным полем
statement_en: The author asserts that DC in any conductor consists of two interacting components: the conduction current inside the conductor and the current of excess charges flowing along the conductor surface, whose carrier mobilities differ strongly; introducing the "surface current of excess charges" enables a non-quantum explanation of autoelectron emission: at room temperature a charge atmosphere always exists in the near-cathode region of a vacuum diode (fed by a small number of thermoelectrons and charges from the external accelerating field); raising the cathode-anode voltage increases the atmosphere height — more excess charges maintain the arising displacement current and the external electrostatic field elastically deforms the atmosphere height; at a threshold external field strength the atmosphere height reaches the cathode-anode distance and the current must appear jump-wise when the atmosphere touches the anode — whereas the quantum model of autoelectron emission has no threshold values or current jumps.
quote_ru: На наш взгляд, постоянный ток в любом проводнике состоит из двух взаимодействующих между собой составляющих

doc_title_en: Mechanisms of matter retention by a self-consistent field
doc_title_ru: Механизмы удержания вещества самосогласованным полем
statement_en: The author states that creating a theory of charge-cluster generation on a tip cathode is pending; it would replace the semi-intuitive experiments described in Shoulders patents with generation devices having preset physical parameters (diameter, layer thickness, surface charge concentration, accumulated charge, lifetime); only this path should yield clusters with charges in the range 1e-6 to 1e-3 C, approaching the charge that, in the author's opinion, can be stored by ball lightning and hence the possibility of its artificial reproduction; cluster-generation technology could produce new energy capsules with limited but controlled lifetime — ecologically clean engines on new physical principles (special conditions would make the cluster explode before radiating at a fixed time after birth) — and also various kinds of "humane" weapons using low-charge ball lightning causing short-term incapacitation.
quote_ru: На очереди стоит также создание теории возникновения зарядо- вого кластера на острийном катоде.

doc_title_ru: Механизмы удержания вещества самосогласованным полем
statement_en: The author lists further applications: replacing spreading bunched electron bunches by charge clusters in straight-through microwave generators should create a new class of microwave devices with output power far exceeding klystrons, traveling-wave and backward-wave tubes; explosions of non-radiated clusters can generate gamma quanta; the most promising task is nonlinear interaction of charge clusters with the wall of a metal resonator where an image charge arises — a path to understanding devices where the usual energy-conservation laws are absent; the discovered elastic deformation of the excess-charge atmosphere thickness sensitive to temperature gradient allows microwave generators on a new physical principle: a vacuum diode in the no-current mode placed in a resonator tuned to the atmosphere-height oscillation frequency will generate oscillations whose frequency depends on the cathode temperature gradient and external field — attractive for a new generation of micron-size solid-state vacuum-electronics devices.

statement_en: The author describes a Shoulders-proposed technology revealing a fundamentally new class of nuclear transformations and reactions in which a flux of high-energy charge clusters serves as the incident "nuclei"; his latest experiments showed a new class of low-energy cluster nuclear reactions arises in the target, in some cases producing new substances absent from the target; Shoulders considers the direction exceptionally promising since such transformations can reduce nuclide radioactivity and be used for nuclear-waste utilization; the author adds the search for nuclear-size clusters — nuclei of only protons (or only electrons, a generalized Cooper-pair analog explaining superconductivity) whose possible existence the theory indicates; generation requires energies comparable to one electronvolt, and decreasing cluster size to nuclear dimensions should sharply increase its lifetime because such systems display quantum properties of ordinary nuclei.
