statement_en: Earlier the inventor Villiam de Honnecourt (France, 1240) demonstrated a 'self-rotating wheel' with seven weights; in Italy in 1438 Mariano di Jacopo built a system of eight rods radially arranged in the plane of rotation; the rods could bend only in one direction, which created a constant asymmetric rotation moment for the gravitational spinner.
quote_ru: Ранее, изобретатель Виллиям де Оннекур (Франция, 1240 год) демонстрировал «самовращающееся колесо» с семью грузами.

doc_title_en: Panegyric to the inexhaustible personal storage of electric energy
doc_title_ru: Панегирик неисчерпаемому персональному накопителю электрической энергии
statement_en: The analysis of the experimental works of our contemporaries in which long rotation of a spinner with magnetic forces was discovered should begin with the Howard Johnson motor (1979); in this motor a rotational moment of magnetic forces was created by the asymmetry of the arrangement of magnets both in the rotor and in the stator; Howard himself could not explain the physics of its long rotation to colleagues from the patent bureau; but the absence of an explanation in no way prevented the motor from rotating continuously.
quote_ru: Анализ экспериментальных работ наших современников, в которых обнаружено длительное вращение вертушки с магнитными силами, следует начинать с мотора Говарда Джонсона (Howard R. Jonson, 1979) [2].
geometry: asymmetric magnet arrangement in rotor and stator

doc_title_en: Panegyric to the inexhaustible personal storage of electric energy
doc_title_ru: Панегирик неисчерпаемому персональному накопителю электрической энергии
statement_en: The simplest and physically understandable asymmetry created in a gravitational spinner was proposed by our contemporary Aldo Costa (France, 2000); information on his invention was published by A. Frolov; the operation of this wheel can be seen on the internet by entering in the search line 'вечный двигатель Альдо Коста'; its radius is more than 10 meters; it has been rotating for about 20 years; true, every three months this 'perpetual motion machine' has to be lubricated.
quote_ru: Самая простая и физически понятная асимметрия, созданная в гравитационной вертушке, была предложена нашим современником Альдо Коста (Aldo Kosta, Франция, 2000 г.).

doc_title_en: Panegyric to the inexhaustible personal storage of electric energy
doc_title_ru: Панегирик неисчерпаемому персональному накопителю электрической энергии
statement_en: Inside the wheel Aldo Costa arranged more than 200 weights which can change their distance from the rotation axis in the 2 half-spaces of motion; these half-spaces are separated by a vertical plane passing through the axis of the wheel; the achieved angular rotation speed is not very large: by our estimates it is of the order of ~0.01 rad/s.
quote_ru: Внутри колеса он расположил более 200 грузиков, которые могут изменять своё расстояние от оси вращения в 2-х полупространствах движения.
geometry: weights movable in 2 half-spaces separated by vertical plane through wheel axis

doc_title_en: Panegyric to the inexhaustible personal storage of electric energy
doc_title_ru: Панегирик неисчерпаемому персональному накопителю электрической энергии
statement_en: What is the cause of the extremely slow spread of the technology of creating various self-rotating spinners and of such great distrust of them? In the author's view this is connected with the thorough mathematical proof of the impossibility of the existence of such an engine invented by academic theorists; it consists in the existence of the circulation theorem: this mathematical theorem asserts that the work performed by a uniform gravitational field on a mass moving in a circle is always zero over the period of such motion; from this follows the inexorable conclusion: transferring the energy of the gravitational field to the moving wheel is impossible, therefore it will never rotate.
quote_ru: Оно заключается в существовании теоремы о циркуляции. Эта математическая теорема утверждает, что работа, совершаемая однородным гравитационным полем над массой, движущейся по окружности, всегда равна нулю за период такого движения.

doc_title_en: Panegyric to the inexhaustible personal storage of electric energy
doc_title_ru: Панегирик неисчерпаемому персональному накопителю электрической энергии
statement_en: Since then it went like this: first the French Academy of Sciences banned considering inventions devoted to 'perpetual motion machines'; then the academies of sciences of other countries joined it; and all of them to this day struggle with the findings of inventors, hindering the unique research of humanity; but 'the wheel does rotate'!
quote_ru: С тех пор так и пошло. Сначала французская академия наук запретила рассматривать изобретения, посвящённые «вечным двигателям».

doc_title_en: Panegyric to the inexhaustible personal storage of electric energy
doc_title_ru: Панегирик неисчерпаемому персональному накопителю электрической энергии
statement_en: The author addresses the presidents of the academies of all countries and peoples: how can it be that the cited mathematical dogma contradicts the experimental research conducted in various countries for more than 200 years and this discourages no one?; such astonishing stubbornness has been hindering for hundreds of years the development of a unique class of long-rotation engines — gravitational, magnetic, and electric; ponder why the circulation theorem does not hinder them from rotating.
quote_ru: Такое поразительное упрямство сотни лет тормозит развитие уникального класса двигателей длительного вращения – гравитационных, магнитных и электрических.

doc_title_en: Panegyric to the inexhaustible personal storage of electric energy
doc_title_ru: Панегирик неисчерпаемому персональному накопителю электрической энергии
statement_en: In response to the mathematical argument of refusal it would be good to recall one of the sayings of the great and authoritative Russian scientist, academician of many academies of the world, M.V. Lomonosov: 'One experiment I place higher than a thousand opinions born only of imagination'; if one looks attentively at the periodic rotation of any weight in a real gravitational spinner, at least four forces always act on this weight: the gravitational force, the support reaction force, the sliding friction force, and the viscous friction force; it is the resultant action of these forces that makes the weight move in a circle; the action of only the gravitational force cannot create circular motion of a body.
quote_ru: Ведь, если внимательно посмотреть на периодическое вращение любого груза в реальной гравитационной вертушке, то на этот груз всегда действуют, как минимум, четыре силы: гравитационная, сила реакции опоры, сила трения скольжения и сила вязкого трения.

doc_title_en: Panegyric to the inexhaustible personal storage of electric energy
doc_title_ru: Панегирик неисчерпаемому персональному накопителю электрической энергии
statement_en: In such motion the gravitational force, of course, performs no work over the period — this is already clear to any student; but during this period it transfers its energy to the weight through the support-reaction force associated with it; one can create an asymmetric moment of forces constantly acting on the wheel; the work of this force moment is always positive.
quote_ru: При таком движении гравитационная сила работу за период, конечно, не совершает.

doc_title_en: Panegyric to the inexhaustible personal storage of electric energy
doc_title_ru: Панегирик неисчерпаемому персональному накопителю электрической энергии
statement_en: The support-reaction force changes its direction in space and its magnitude over the period; and its circulation, understandably, is not equal to zero; this circulation coincides with the value of the work transferred to the spinner by the gravitational field over the period; this leads to understanding under what physical conditions the spinner will rotate and by what equation its motion is described; any student of a technical university familiar with rotational dynamics can now compose this equation: I·dω/dt = M0 − M1 − M2 (1), where I is the moment of inertia of the wheel, ω the angular velocity depending on time, and M0, M1, M2 three moments of forces acting on the spinner axis: M0 — the asymmetric rotation moment, M1 — the moment of sliding (rolling) friction forces in the bearing, M2 — the moment of viscous friction forces of air, which depends linearly on the angular rotation speed of the spinner, i.e. M2 = ηω, where η is the rotational viscosity coefficient.
quote_ru: Сила реакции опоры изменяет своё направление в пространстве и величину за период.

doc_title_en: Panegyric to the inexhaustible personal storage of electric energy
doc_title_ru: Панегирик неисчерпаемому персональному накопителю электрической энергии
statement_en: The solutions of this equation are well studied by the mathematicians of the last century: they describe the laws of establishment in time of the angular velocity of the wheel motion after its start with a certain initial angular velocity ω0; the solutions single out the characteristic time scale of the transition of the spinner into stationary long rotation; there one can also find solutions describing the possible stoppage of the wheel after the disappearance of the asymmetric rotation moment.
quote_ru: Решения этого уравнения хорошо изучены математиками прошлого века.

doc_title_en: Panegyric to the inexhaustible personal storage of electric energy
doc_title_ru: Панегирик неисчерпаемому персональному накопителю электрической энергии
statement_en: The most important information follows from (1): it determines the value of the angular velocity of the 'eternal rotation' of the spinner (dω/dt = 0): ω* = (M0 − M1)/η (2); from (2) the magnitude of the angular rotation velocity of the spinner depends on the difference of the moments of the rotation forces and the friction forces, and also on the magnitude of the rotational viscosity of air; the angular velocity does not depend on the moment of inertia of the system; engines in which the moment of the friction forces exceeds the asymmetric one will not rotate.
quote_ru: Самая важная информация следует из (1). Она определяет значение угловой скорости «вечного вращения» вертушки

doc_title_en: Panegyric to the inexhaustible personal storage of electric energy
doc_title_ru: Панегирик неисчерпаемому персональному накопителю электрической энергии
statement_en: The obtained relations allow proposing adequate procedures of measuring the parameters entering the relations (1), (2) of any spinners, and also stimulating the creation of new constructive schemes of rotational energy generators having a diverse spectrum of angular rotation speeds; the time has come to repeat the unique mechanical experiments of past centuries.
quote_ru: Полученные соотношения позволяют предложить адекватные процедуры измерения параметров, входящих в соотношения (1), (2) любых вертушек, а также стимулировать создание новых конструктивных схем генераторов вращательной энергии, имеющих разнообразный спектр угловых скоростей вращения.
procedure_steps: measure parameters of (1), (2) for any spinner
develop new constructive schemes of rotational energy generators

doc_title_en: Panegyric to the inexhaustible personal storage of electric energy
doc_title_ru: Панегирик неисчерпаемому персональному накопителю электрической энергии
statement_en: But the most astonishing 'perpetual motion machine', autonomously producing electric energy without the supply of energy from outside, was invented in Switzerland in the 1990s of the last century by the engineer Paul Bauman.
quote_ru: Но самый удивительный «вечный двигатель», автономно вырабатывающий электрическую энергию без подведения энергии извне, был изобретён в Швейцарии в 90-х годах прошлого века инженером Полем Бауманом.

doc_title_en: Panegyric to the inexhaustible personal storage of electric energy
doc_title_ru: Панегирик неисчерпаемому персональному накопителю электрической энергии
statement_en: The inventor Paul Bauman calls his devices Testatik Machine M/L Converter from the religious group 'Methernitha' (address: Methernitha, CH-3517 Linden, Switzerland), further — 'Testatika'; his community took no patents on these devices; it was rumored that they pay nothing to the electric companies supplying the town of Linden; the community did not sell these devices either in Switzerland or on the market; it is known that they managed to build several different installations at the power of 100 W, 300 W, 3 kW, and 10 kW; video clips with these working devices can still be found on the internet.
quote_ru: Известно, что им удалось построить несколько различных установок на мощность 100 Вт, 300 Вт, 3 кВт и 10 кВт.
quantities: installation powers: 100 W, 300 W, 3 kW, 10 kW

doc_title_en: Panegyric to the inexhaustible personal storage of electric energy
doc_title_ru: Панегирик неисчерпаемому персональному накопителю электрической энергии
statement_en: Information brought from Switzerland three years ago indicates that Paul Bauman stopped producing his electric sources; one low-power non-working device was placed in a museum; in the museum tourists are told not only about the ability of the Swiss to make good cheese and chocolate but also that they learned to extract electricity from the energy of the counter rotation of disks, which suffices for the needs of one small house for years.
quote_ru: Информация, привезённая из Швейцарии три года назад, указывает на то, что Поль Бауман прекратил выпускать свои электрические источники.

doc_title_en: Panegyric to the inexhaustible personal storage of electric energy
doc_title_ru: Панегирик неисчерпаемому персональному накопителю электрической энергии
statement_en: The first information on how Bauman's installations are arranged appeared in Austria in 1989; their description can be found in the book of professor S. Marinov; later they were mentioned in the book of professor L. Sapogin and in the monograph of A. Frolov.
quote_ru: Первые сведения о том, как устроены установки П.Баумана, появились в Австрии в 1989 году.

doc_title_en: Panegyric to the inexhaustible personal storage of electric energy
doc_title_ru: Панегирик неисчерпаемому персональному накопителю электрической энергии
statement_en: Unfortunately neither the inventors themselves nor professor Marinov could give a coherent explanation of the chain of physical phenomena long-generating excess electric energy in the Testatika installation; it is known that such an installation has not yet been replicated by anyone in Russia or in the world, despite the fact that its detailed color drawings have been posted on the internet by the Russian laboratory Faradey-Lab for the last 20 years.
quote_ru: Известно, что подобную установку пока не удалось повторить никому в России и в мире, несмотря на то, что её подробные цветные чертежи выложены в Интернет российской лабораторией Faradey-Lab [1] уже на протяжении последних 20 лет.

doc_title_en: Panegyric to the inexhaustible personal storage of electric energy
doc_title_ru: Панегирик неисчерпаемому персональному накопителю электрической энергии
statement_en: In the author's opinion the new electromechanical system combines a rotating motor and a generator forming a closed energy chain; while the periodically changing capacitance participates in the self-rotation it continuously supplies energy to the closed electric circuit; the load circuit includes high-voltage Tesla transformers and chokes with neodymium magnets; the energy supplied to the circuit is sufficient to cover all the losses of the system over the same period.
quote_ru: Пока периодически изменяющаяся ёмкость участвует в самовращении, она непрерывно поставляет энергию в замкнутую электрическую цепь.

doc_title_en: Panegyric to the inexhaustible personal storage of electric energy
doc_title_ru: Панегирик неисчерпаемому персональному накопителю электрической энергии
statement_en: In [5] we studied a class of dissipative physical systems named 'closed energy chains' (CEC technology) possessing the properties listed above (the brochure can be found at www.physics-evolution.ru); the scientific direction 'Closed dissipative systems of periodic energy conversion' is included in the Registry of NEW SCIENTIFIC DIRECTIONS of RAE, vol. 3, 2019; the author is confident that Bauman's 'Testatika' machine is a prototype of exactly such systems; the operating principles of CEC systems allow creating three classes of original technical devices.
quote_ru: В [5] нами исследован класс диссипативных физических систем, названных «закольцованные энергетические цепочки» (ЗЭЦ  технология), которые обладают вышеперечисленными свойствами

doc_title_en: Panegyric to the inexhaustible personal storage of electric energy
doc_title_ru: Панегирик неисчерпаемому персональному накопителю электрической энергии
statement_en: The first class of devices — devices converting mechanical rotation into alternating electric current, known as mechano-electric converters; they are built on the principle of the Mandelshtam-Papaleksi parametric generators with a large variable capacitance; regimes of superunity conversion of mechanical energy into electric energy exist in them.
quote_ru: Первый класс устройств – устройства, преобразующие механическое вращение в переменный электрический ток, известные как механо-электрические преобразователи.

doc_title_en: Panegyric to the inexhaustible personal storage of electric energy
doc_title_ru: Панегирик неисчерпаемому персональному накопителю электрической энергии
statement_en: The second class of devices — devices converting voltage into mechanical rotation, i.e. electro-mechanical converters operating on the mirror physical principle; these are analogs of the Litovchenko-Bologo electrostatic motors, prototypes of Franklin's electric wheel; special commercial interest apparently presents the creation of microengines on MEMS technologies; they will not differ strongly from the nano-size motor-generators recently discovered by biologists in flagellate bacteria flagellar motors.
quote_ru: Второй класс устройств – устройства, преобразующие напряжение в механическое вращение, т.е., электро-механические преобразователи, работающие на зеркальном физическом принципе.

doc_title_en: Panegyric to the inexhaustible personal storage of electric energy
doc_title_ru: Панегирик неисчерпаемому персональному накопителю электрической энергии
statement_en: The third class of devices — storages of electric energy (prototypes of Bauman's storage) which can supply excess energy to the consumer in the presence of the current instability discovered theoretically in a series oscillating circuit.
quote_ru: Третий класс устройств – накопители электрической энергии (прототипы накопителя Поля Баумана), которые могут поставлять избыточную энергию потребителю при наличии токовой неустойчивости, обнаруженной теоретически, в последовательном колебательном контуре [8].

doc_title_en: Panegyric to the inexhaustible personal storage of electric energy
doc_title_ru: Панегирик неисчерпаемому персональному накопителю электрической энергии
statement_en: Astonishingly, Nature allows humanity to create a personal, autonomous, inexhaustible, ecologically clean, cheap storage of electric energy; the technologies of its creation should be classified as breakthrough technologies of the 21st century; no, even exclusively beautiful, mathematical theorems will be able to forbid it to generate alternating-current electric energy from mechanical self-rotation.
quote_ru: Поразительно, но Природа позволяет человечеству создать персональный, автономный, неисчерпаемый, экологически чистый, дешёвый накопитель электрической энергии.

doc_title_en: Panegyric to the inexhaustible personal storage of electric energy
doc_title_ru: Панегирик неисчерпаемому персональному накопителю электрической энергии
statement_en: The advantage of the electric energy storages is that they require no recharging and no external energy supply for their continuous operation; the most important property of such personal generators is that no harmful radiations are present during their operation.
quote_ru: Достоинство накопителей электрической энергии заключается в том, что они не требуют для своей непрерывной работы подзарядки и подвода энергии извне.

doc_title_en: Panegyric to the inexhaustible personal storage of electric energy
doc_title_ru: Панегирик неисчерпаемому персональному накопителю электрической энергии
statement_en: Are there flaws in such storages? Certainly: any technical device has numerous flaws; the operation of the storage requires continuous counter mechanical rotation of disks of large diameter; in high-power installations this will create high-intensity noises from which the energy consumer will need to be protected.
quote_ru: Есть ли недостатки у таких накопителей? Наверняка.

doc_title_en: Panegyric to the inexhaustible personal storage of electric energy
doc_title_ru: Панегирик неисчерпаемому персональному накопителю электрической энергии
statement_en: The CEC technology will allow in the future creating electric energy storages without mechanical rotation: in them the electric capacitance with mechanical rotation will be replaced by an immobile capacitance with an oscillating dipole electric moment; the realization of such a storage is possible only after measuring the electric parameters obtained in a working prototype with mechanical rotation.
quote_ru: ЗЭЦ - технология позволит в будущем создавать накопители электрической энергии без механического вращения.
procedure_steps: measure electric parameters of working mechanical-rotation prototype
replace rotating capacitance by immobile capacitance with oscillating dipole moment

doc_title_en: Panegyric to the inexhaustible personal storage of electric energy
doc_title_ru: Панегирик неисчерпаемому персональному накопителю электрической энергии
statement_en: The proposed model of the operation of the personal engine/generator substantiates the mechanism of generation of rotational kinetic and electric energies existing in Nature; the generation of excess energy is confirmed by numerous experiments of recent years; the mechanism can help the energy industry in solving the problem of producing a personal storage not requiring the supply of energy from outside.
quote_ru: Предложена модель работы такого накопителя в виде закольцованной энергетической цепочки. Модель объясняет механизм генерации вращательной кинетической и электрической энергий, существующий в Природе.

doc_title_en: Physical foundations of promoting the technology of creating a varicap with an electron cluster
doc_title_ru: Физические основы продвижения технологии создания варикапа с электронным кластером
statement_en: School-physics background: a gas balloon holds gas whose pressure varies within certain limits — a glass balloon can withstand pressure up to about three times atmospheric, at four times it explodes; metal oxygen cylinders can withstand ten times atmospheric pressure; if a filled gas balloon is thrown into a furnace and heated it will eventually explode — the causes can be explained in different physical terms: (1) the gas pressure in the balloon exceeded the pressure the metal balloon can withstand; (2) the temperature of the heated molecular gas turned out higher than the characteristic temperature of the metal balloon; gas balloons usually indicate the limit pressure in megapascals (10^6 Pa).
quote_ru: Металлические баллоны с кислородом могут выдерживать уже десятикратное давление атмосферы.

doc_title_en: Physical foundations of promoting the technology of creating a varicap with an electron cluster
doc_title_ru: Физические основы продвижения технологии создания варикапа с электронным кластером
statement_en: The posed task: we have a vessel representing a charge bubble (the same as a gas of molecules in a 'glass balloon') heated to a definite temperature, and we need to estimate the most important cluster parameters; from them to understand at what concentrations and temperatures (the role of glass is played by the field pressure formed by the charges; the retention condition: the field pressure must equal the charge pressure) this system will be retained; only one who has built the physical theory of charge clusters and understands it can make these estimates.
quote_ru: И нам с вами нужно сделать оценки важнейших параметров кластера. Из них нужно понять, при каких концентрациях и температурах (роль стекла играет давление поля, образованное зарядами; условие удержания: давление поля должно быть равно давлению зарядов) эта система будет удерживаться.

doc_title_en: Physical foundations of promoting the technology of creating a varicap with an electron cluster
doc_title_ru: Физические основы продвижения технологии создания варикапа с электронным кластером
statement_en: The physics is also simple: if the charge pressure turns out greater than the field pressure, the cluster either explodes or increases its size; if the field pressure is greater than the charge pressure, the charge bubble compresses; the charge pressure, as in an ordinary gas, is determined directly by their temperature (the school formula p = nkT); i.e. in a diode the creation of a gas medium consisting of individual electrons with a definite concentration and definite temperature is possible; charge bubbles can also be in the medium; in clusters the electric fields always counteract the thermal fields.
quote_ru: Физика вроде тоже простая: если давление зарядов окажется больше давления поля, то кластер либо взорвётся, либо увеличит свои размеры.

doc_title_en: Physical foundations of promoting the technology of creating a varicap with an electron cluster
doc_title_ru: Физические основы продвижения технологии создания варикапа с электронным кластером
statement_en: Four parameters — concentration, temperature, potential of the system, and charge — determine the existence of such a stationary charge cluster in which at any place of the cluster the field pressure equals the local charge pressure; a situation is possible when at these parameters a cluster of, say, 4 meters forms; such a size does not fit the dimensions of a vacuum diode; and since this is so, expecting the appearance of Shoulders' micron clusters in such a gas medium can take years — one begins to understand that in such a 'broth' they may never appear at all.
quote_ru: Четыре параметра: концентрация, температура, потенциал системы и заряд, – определяют существование такого стационарного зарядового кластера, в котором в любом месте кластера давление поля

doc_title_en: Physical foundations of promoting the technology of creating a varicap with an electron cluster
doc_title_ru: Физические основы продвижения технологии создания варикапа с электронным кластером
statement_en: In a charge cluster there is the dimensionless parameter eφ/kT (1), where e is the electron charge, φ the mean electric potential of the cluster, k the Boltzmann constant, T the absolute temperature of the cluster; from parameter (1) one can extract its characteristic temperature T* = eφ/k ≈ φ·10^4 K (2), which defines the characteristic temperature scale of any electron cluster located under a mean potential.
quote_ru: Из параметра (1) можно вычленить его характеристическую температуру
quantities: T* = e phi/k ~ phi x 1e4 K

doc_title_en: Physical foundations of promoting the technology of creating a varicap with an electron cluster
doc_title_ru: Физические основы продвижения технологии создания варикапа с электронным кластером
statement_en: As multi-year experiments with the vacuum diode show, at a cathode surface temperature of 1000 K an electron gas with a mean potential of the order of 1 millivolt forms; this figure is obtained from the volt-ampere characteristic of a lockable vacuum diode of centimeter dimensions: take a vacuum diode, switch on the filament, and apply a negative blocking voltage to the anode; it is increased until the current through the diode stops.
quote_ru: Как показывают многолетние эксперименты с вакуумным диодом, при температуре поверхности катода 1000 К образуется газ электронов со средним потенциалом порядка 1 милливольт.
procedure_steps: heat the filament
apply negative blocking voltage to anode
increase until current stops
read blocking potential from V-A characteristic

measurements.conditions: cathode surface at 1000 K, blocking-voltage method

doc_title_en: Physical foundations of promoting the technology of creating a varicap with an electron cluster
doc_title_ru: Физические основы продвижения технологии создания варикапа с электронным кластером
statement_en: For diodes of different types this value may differ, but still it has an order of magnitude of a potential of about 1 millivolt (the main thing is the order of the physical quantity); the potential determines the characteristic temperature (2): for the electron cluster of such diodes T* = 10 K; comparing this temperature with the 1000 K of the cathode generating them, the electron cluster is cold and resides in a 'glacial period'.
quote_ru: Видно, что у электронного кластера таких диодов температура T* =10 К. Если эту температуру сравнить с температурой 1000 К рождающего их катода, то электронный кластер – холодный. И он пребывает в «ледниковом периоде».

doc_title_en: Physical foundations of promoting the technology of creating a varicap with an electron cluster
doc_title_ru: Физические основы продвижения технологии создания варикапа с электронным кластером
statement_en: The physical parameters of the cluster appearing at the surface of a heated cathode were calculated for the voltage between anode and cathode equal to zero; applying voltage to the electrodes is equivalent to introducing thermal energy into the gas of thermoelectrons; it will necessarily increase its temperature; the higher the voltage on the electrodes, the higher the heating of the thermoelectrons.
quote_ru: Мы рассчитали физические параметры кластера, который появляется у поверхности нагретого катода при напряжении между анодом и катодом, равным нулю.

doc_title_en: Physical foundations of promoting the technology of creating a varicap with an electron cluster
doc_title_ru: Физические основы продвижения технологии создания варикапа с электронным кластером
statement_en: If a mean voltage of the order of 30,000 V is applied to the electrodes of a vacuum diode, it is the same as heating a gas balloon to a characteristic temperature of 300 million Kelvin (hundreds of times higher than the temperature inside the Sun's plasma); calculation: T* = eφ/k = (1.6·10⁻¹⁹ × 30000)/(1.38·10⁻²³) = 3·10⁸ K.
quote_ru: Если к электродам вакуумного диода приложить среднее напряжение порядка 30 000 В, то это всё равно, что нагреть баллон с газом до характеристической температуры 300 миллионов Кельвин (это в сотни раз выше, чем температура внутри плазмы Солнца).
quantities: T* = 3e8 K (hundreds of times above solar-plasma interior)

doc_title_en: Physical foundations of promoting the technology of creating a varicap with an electron cluster
doc_title_ru: Физические основы продвижения технологии создания варикапа с электронным кластером
statement_en: In the brochure 'Technologies of personal power engineering on bubble structures of charges' p. 23 formula (1) is given by which the spatial size (the cluster radius) can be calculated; keeping the same electron concentration in the cluster (1.9·10¹¹ per cubic meter — such concentration is standard for vacuum diodes at temperatures from 1000 to 2000 K), the possible cluster radius for a temperature of 300 million Kelvin comes out 400 times greater than the cluster radius of 1 cm for a temperature of 2000 K; it is completely clear that such a 'porcupine' will not fit into lamps of centimeter sizes.
quote_ru: Совершенно ясно, что такой «дикобраз» в лампы сантиметровых размеров не поместится.
quantities: electron concentration 1.9e11 m^-3 (standard for vacuum diodes at 1000-2000 K)
radius grows 400x from 1 cm at 2000 K to ~4 m at 3e8 K
geometry: cluster radius 1 cm at 2000 K; ~4 m at 3e8 K

doc_title_en: Physical foundations of promoting the technology of creating a varicap with an electron cluster
doc_title_ru: Физические основы продвижения технологии создания варикапа с электронным кластером
statement_en: This says that at the input of such voltages into the diode one cannot expect the appearance of a micron-size cluster; the author thought that inside the diode with external anode a countless number of them would form; each of them has its own spherical surface area; multiplying this area by their countless number would increase the effective capacitance area of the VC (varicap with cluster), and its capacitance would increase from 10^6 to 10^9 times.
quote_ru: Каждый из них имеет свою площадь сферической поверхности. Если умножить эту площадь на их несметное количество, то это увеличит эффективную площадь ёмкости ВК, и его ёмкость увеличится от 106 до 109 раз.

doc_title_en: Physical foundations of promoting the technology of creating a varicap with an electron cluster
doc_title_ru: Физические основы продвижения технологии создания варикапа с электронным кластером
statement_en: But the addressee's experiments of recent years with various vacuum diodes did not detect the expected physical situation; yet in the initial studies conducted by the addressee in Petersburg such clusters arose and changed the capacitance to very large values.
quote_ru: Но ваши эксперименты последних лет с различными вакуумными диодами не обнаружили предполагаемой физической ситуации.

doc_title_en: Physical foundations of promoting the technology of creating a varicap with an electron cluster
doc_title_ru: Физические основы продвижения технологии создания варикапа с электронным кластером
statement_en: The author thinks that in Petersburg the addressee accidentally stumbled on the effect of capacitance increase; it can be assumed that in those experiments the surfaces of the cathodes of the used lamps had roughness; their cathodes nobody thought of polishing; there were quite a few roughnesses — at least enough for the capacitance-increase effect to be noticeable.
quote_ru: Думаю, что в Питере вы случайно натолкнулись на эффект увеличения ёмкости.

doc_title_en: Physical foundations of promoting the technology of creating a varicap with an electron cluster
doc_title_ru: Физические основы продвижения технологии создания варикапа с электронным кластером
statement_en: Those vacuum diodes (French kenotrons) that the addressee investigated were apparently well made and lacked the needed number of sharp-point elements (or surface roughnesses, as with G. Mesyats) on the cathode surface; they did not supply micron charge bubbles into the electron gas; the latest experiments showed the development of an electric plasma instability inside the electron gas; what did this instability do to the electrons? When a large-amplitude pulse was applied, the electron gas, heating up, began chaotic motion and formed various growth fronts; hot electrons strove to leave into cold regions; the electrons heated these regions and again sought cold regions; at that, the instability could not generate any charge clusters.
quote_ru: Что показали последние эксперименты? Они показали развитие электрической плазменной неустойчивости внутри электронного газа.

doc_title_en: Physical foundations of promoting the technology of creating a varicap with an electron cluster
doc_title_ru: Физические основы продвижения технологии создания варикапа с электронным кластером
statement_en: If the kenotrons had rough elements in the needed quantity, they would generate micron Shoulders charge clusters; in the bubbles the charge concentration would be higher than in the surrounding 'broth' by 8 orders; precisely they would change the capacitance of the system; such a bubble jumps out of the point with a diameter of 10 micrometers, then increases its diameter 400 times without exploding — becoming 4 millimeters in size but remaining in the diode; the geometric length of the vacuum gap in these lamps is centimeters; there should be thousands of such unexploded bubbles, maybe more; but where to get them if the cathode lacks the centers generating them.
quote_ru: Если бы в кенотронах были шероховатые элементы в нужном количестве, то они бы порождали микронные зарядовые кластеры Шоулдерса.
quantities: bubble concentration 8 orders above surrounding gas
bubble diameter 10 um, expanding 400x to 4 mm

doc_title_en: Physical foundations of promoting the technology of creating a varicap with an electron cluster
doc_title_ru: Физические основы продвижения технологии создания варикапа с электронным кластером
statement_en: Therefore one needs to create one's own design of a vacuum diode which must give Shoulders clusters; the addressee was designing diodes with small point cathodes; only micron-size clusters should be introduced into the vacuum accumulator.
quote_ru: Поэтому нужно создать свой конструктив вакуумного диода, который должен давать кластеры Шоулдерса.

doc_title_en: Physical foundations of promoting the technology of creating a varicap with an electron cluster
doc_title_ru: Физические основы продвижения технологии создания варикапа с электронным кластером
statement_en: Constructive proposal for an atmospheric current discharger in another variant: the cathode should be a metal cone of a material withstanding a heating temperature of 3000 K (probably tungsten); assume the large base diameter 1-2 cm; the small base should be ground and polished to micron sizes; the cone angle 30 degrees relative to the axis; attach to the large base a heater rated for the required power of heating the cone from 1000 K to 2000 K (see fig. 5 on p. 43 of 'Технологии…'); at an axial distance from 2 mm to 5 cm (a way to vary this distance should be considered) place co-axially a cylindrical anode in the form of a Faraday cage with a lid of diameter from 2 to 4 cm; assemble all this on a vacuum stand; the result is exactly the same diode as Shoulders's, but differing from his design by the macroscopic size of the point cathode and the cathode heating.
quote_ru: Пусть катод будет из металлического конуса (материал такой, чтобы мог выдерживать температуру нагрева в 3000 К, – наверное, вольфрам).
geometry: cone base 1-2 cm, small base micron-size, angle 30 degrees
anode diameter 2-4 cm at 2 mm-5 cm axial distance
procedure_steps: make tungsten cone cathode with micron polished tip
attach heater to large base (1000-2000 K)
place Faraday-cage cylindrical anode coaxially at 2 mm-5 cm
assemble on vacuum stand

doc_title_en: Physical foundations of promoting the technology of creating a varicap with an electron cluster
doc_title_ru: Физические основы продвижения технологии создания варикапа с электронным кластером
statement_en: Why is a point cathode needed? In such geometry the electrons begin to move away from the heated large surface of the cone toward the point, into the cold region; the temperature gradient pushes them; the collective electric field retains them in such a way that they cannot jump out through the lateral surface of the cone; therefore single electrons cannot appear in the vacuum gap in this variant; it is the same as making a conical metal pipe: passing water through such a fitting one achieves its exit through the small hole under high pressure.
quote_ru: Почему нужен острийный катод? Всё дело в том, что в такой геометрии электроны начинают уходить от нагретой большой поверхности конуса к острию в холодную область.

statement_en: Information published on site [1] (G. Detinich, 'Chinese scientists developed a 3-nm transistor', 3dnews.ru/988458) states that Chinese technologists were the first in the world to create the smallest-size capacitance with a distance between plates of 4 nm; it possessed unexpected properties: the capacitance arose at a small voltage applied to the metal plates, increased jumpwise, and then decreased inversely proportional to the external voltage.
quote_ru: Она обладала неожиданными свойствами: ёмкость возникала при небольшом напряжении, приложенному к металлическим обкладкам, увеличивалась скачком, а затем убывала обратно пропорционально внешнему напряжению.

doc_title_en: Physical properties of nanoscale varicaps and their application
doc_title_ru: Физические свойства наноразмерных варикапов и их применение
statement_en: Russian technologists from the Southern Federal University (SFU) A. Razumnaya and Yu. Tikhonov also created a similar capacitance with a distance between plates of 10 nm; they explained the origin of the capacitance by the existence in the film of a movable domain wall whose dipole structure was oriented so that the capacitance, as the authors assert, became negative; the film exhibited the same property as with the Chinese technologists: its capacitance decreased inversely proportional to the external voltage; this indicates that the physical mechanism of formation of the double electric layer in a film of nanoscale thickness under an external static electric field has the same, still unknown to technologists, nature.
quote_ru: Происхождение ёмкости они объяснили существованием в плёнке подвижной доменной стенки, дипольная структура которой была сориентирована так, что ёмкость, как утверждают авторы, стала отрицательной.

doc_title_en: Physical properties of nanoscale varicaps and their application
doc_title_ru: Физические свойства наноразмерных варикапов и их применение
statement_en: American researchers of harvesters under the guidance of professor P.M. Thibado created a capacitor one electrode of which consisted of a graphene film and the other was pointed; they discovered two different cases of dipole-moment distribution in graphene: the first case was realized when the electric energy stored in the elementary layer of the film was of the order of its thermal energy — the thermal energy made the electric moment of the film dipole change chaotically in time and space, which changed the magnitude of the bending deformation of the film caught in the external electric field, and it oscillated randomly in time and generated a fluctuation-induction current; the second case of large electric fields stored in the film electric energy orders of magnitude greater than thermal; the dipole structures oriented mainly in one direction and practically did not depend on time; the transfer of thermal energy to them did not lead to a change of their dipole moment in space; generation of the fluctuation-induction current was absent.
quote_ru: Американские исследователи харвейстеров под руководством профессора П.М.Тибадо создали конденсатор, один электрод которого состоял из плёнки графена, а другой был острийным.

statement_en: Recently an idea came to the author which, he believes, can clarify the previously unknown physical mechanism of formation of such a capacitance; the mechanism allows understanding, explaining, and calculating the measured dependence of capacitance on voltage for various film structures consisting of conductors or semiconductors; the idea turned out closely connected with the methods of calculating charge clusters discovered experimentally by the American researcher K. Shoulders at the end of the last century; using the methods of calculating the distribution of substance in charge bubbles the author prepared the monograph 'Mechanisms of matter retention by a self-consistent field' and published about 20 scientific works.
quote_ru: Механизм позволяет понять, объяснить и рассчитать измеренную зависимость ёмкости от напряжения для различных плёночных структур, состоящих из проводников, либо полупроводников.

quote_ru: Первый вариант структуры: металлическая обкладка – диэлектрик – металлическая плёнка – диэлектрик – металлическая обкладка.

doc_title_en: Physical properties of nanoscale varicaps and their application
doc_title_ru: Физические свойства наноразмерных варикапов и их применение
statement_en: The fact of the appearance of capacitance in a film of nanometer thickness can be explained by the formation in the structure of a double electric layer in which the decisive role is played by the free electrons of the film plasma.
quote_ru: Факт появления ёмкости в плёнке толщиной в нанометры можно объяснить тем, что в структуре возникает двойной электрический слой, определяющую роль в котором играют свободные электроны плазмы плёнки.

doc_title_en: Physical properties of nanoscale varicaps and their application
doc_title_ru: Физические свойства наноразмерных варикапов и их применение
statement_en: If a static electric field is applied to a thin film then, at strength values greater than the intracrystalline field strength, an electric instability of the solid-body plasma arises — a new physical effect explaining the polarization properties of the solid-body plasma; the plasma instability arises because at such high strengths the pressure of the external field turns out greater than the pressure of the electron gas of the solid body at the given temperature; the electrization of the solid-body plasma arising under pressure leads to a macroscopic separation of charges; the electrons are thrown off by the field and form the dipole electric moment of the film.
quote_ru: Неустойчивость плазмы возникает потому, что при таких высоких напряжённостях давление внешнего поля оказывается больше, чем давление газа электронов твёрдого тела при данной температуре.

doc_title_en: Physical properties of nanoscale varicaps and their application
doc_title_ru: Физические свойства наноразмерных варикапов и их применение
statement_en: Estimates show that a film of thickness 4 nm (room temperature, free-electron concentration 10^25 m⁻³) forms a double electric layer at a breakdown voltage of 0.4 V; a film of thickness 40 nanometers polarizes already at a voltage of about 4 V; the working voltage of the capacitor is always greater than the voltage of the plasma-instability breakdown; the varicap capacitance is small at voltages less than the breakdown voltage; at the breakdown voltage it is the largest and then decreases inversely proportional to the external voltage; the approximate volt-farad characteristic is presented in Fig. 1.
quote_ru: Оценки показывают, что плёнка толщиной 4 нм (температура комнатная, концентрация свободных электронов 1025 м-3) образует двойной электрический слой при напряжении срыва 0,4 В.
quantities: 4 nm film: breakdown at 0.4 V (n = 1e25 m^-3, room T)

statement_en: The instability manifested itself in strongly inhomogeneous charge regions forming in the graphene; they fluctuated in time creating in the whole film a total dipole moment which changed its direction in space and time; the resulting chaotic electric field generated by the integral dipole moment strongly depended on the seed value of the external DC electric field strength.
quote_ru: Она проявила себя в том, что в графене стали образовываться сильно неоднородные области зарядов.

statement_en: Two different cases of dipole-moment distribution were discovered: the first case was realized when the electric energy stored in the elementary plasma layer was of the order of its thermal energy — the thermal energy made the electric moment of the dipole change chaotically in time and space, which changed the magnitude of the bending deformation of the film caught in the field, and it swayed randomly in time generating a fluctuation-induction current; the second case of large electric fields stored in the film electric energy orders of magnitude greater than thermal; the dipole structures oriented mainly in one direction and practically did not depend on time; the transfer of thermal energy to them did not lead to a change of their dipole moment in space; generation of the fluctuation-induction current was absent.
quote_ru: Первый случай реализовался тогда, когда электрическая энергия, запасённая в элементарном плазменном слое, была порядка его тепловой энергии.
